Электрон в атоме не летает по орбите, ка: An electron in an atom does not fly along an orbit like a planet. It is smeared out into a cloud of probability, an orbital, and orbitals have shapes: a sphere, a dumbbell, a four-leaf clover. How many electrons an atom has and how they are arranged in orbitals determines everything the atom can do in chemistry. Compare four elements from which stars, the Earth and you yourself are mostly built.
Форму орбиталей дало уравнение Шрёдингер: The shapes of the orbitals came from the Schrödinger equation (1926). The cloud on screen is a map of probability: where the dots are denser, the electron is found more often
Принцип Паули (1925): на одной орбитали: The Pauli principle (1925): no more than two electrons per orbital. That is why electrons fill shells in layers (1s, 2s, 2p, 3s…) and the properties of elements repeat in periods

Больше 99,9 % массы атома собрано в крош: More than 99.9% of an atom’s mass is packed into its tiny nucleus. If an atom were blown up to the size of a stadium, the nucleus would be a pea at the center of the field. The protons in the nucleus repel each other, but they are held together by the strong interaction, the most powerful force in nature, though it acts only over distances the size of the nucleus itself. The nucleus hides both the clocks by which the Earth is dated and the furnace in which stars forge the elements.
Ядро открыл Резерфорд в 1911 году: альфа: Rutherford discovered the nucleus in 1911: alpha particles fired at thin gold foil occasionally bounced straight back. This meant that almost all the mass of the atom is compressed into a point
Плотность ядерного вещества — около 2·10: The density of nuclear matter is about 2·10¹⁷ kg/m³: a teaspoon of it would weigh on the order of a billion tons
Беккерель открыл радиоактивность в 1896: Becquerel discovered radioactivity in 1896, and Marie and Pierre Curie discovered polonium and radium in 1898. In 1902 Rutherford and Soddy realized that in decaying, one element turns into another
Когда распадётся отдельное ядро, предска: When a single nucleus will decay cannot be predicted, but half of the nuclei decay in a strictly defined time, the half-life. Radiocarbon (≈5,700 years) dates bone and wood up to ~50,000 years old; uranium-238 (4.47 billion years) dates the oldest zircon crystals, which are 4.4 billion years old
Звёзды — кузницы элементов. Слияние лёгк: Stars are forges of elements. Fusing light nuclei releases energy all the way up to iron and nickel, which have the highest binding energy per nucleon. Every second the Sun turns about 600 million tons of hydrogen into helium
Ядра тяжелее железа рождаются захватом н: Nuclei heavier than iron are born through neutron capture: slow capture in old giant stars and rapid capture when neutron stars merge. Such a merger was first “heard” in gravitational waves in 2017 (GW170817), and newborn heavy elements were seen in its light

Протон — не шарик. Внутри три кварка, св: A proton is not a little ball. Inside are three quarks bound by a field of gluons, and around them boils a “sea” of quark–antiquark pairs that appear and vanish at once. The quarks constantly exchange “color”, the name physicists gave to the charge of the strong interaction, but together they always form a colorless whole. Try to pull out one quark.
Кварки предложили независимо Гелл-Манн и: Quarks were proposed independently by Gell-Mann and Zweig in 1964; Gell-Mann took the word from Joyce’s “Finnegans Wake”. In 1968, at the Stanford accelerator (SLAC), electrons scattered off protons revealed point-like particles inside them
Сами кварки дают около 1 % массы протона: The quarks themselves account for about 1% of a proton’s mass. The other 99% is the energy of their motion and of the gluon field: E = mc² in action. In 2008 this was confirmed by supercomputer calculations (lattice QCD)
Сила между кварками с расстоянием не сла: The force between quarks does not weaken with distance: the field tube pulls with a force on the order of the weight of 15 tons. If you pull further, the tube’s energy is enough to create a new quark–antiquark pair, and instead of a free quark a meson flies out. This is called confinement, the “imprisonment” of quarks
Вблизи друг друга кварки, наоборот, почт: Close together, on the other hand, quarks are almost free: asymptotic freedom (Gross, Wilczek and Politzer, 1973; Nobel Prize 2004)
Давление в центре протона — около 10³⁵ п: The pressure at the center of a proton is about 10³⁵ pascals, higher than inside a neutron star (Burkert and colleagues, 2018)
Протон, похоже, вечен: его распад ни раз: The proton seems to be eternal: its decay has never been observed, and its lifetime exceeds 10³⁴ years. A free neutron lives about 15 minutes, but inside a nucleus it is stable
Модель условная: «цвета» кварков — назва: The model is schematic: the quark “colors” are names of charges, not colors; quarks are not balls, the field tube has no sharp thickness, and distances are stretched

But the dots add up to fringes, as if each electron went through both slits at once and met itself, like a wave. Put a detector at the slits that records which slit the electron went through, and the fringes disappear.
Опыт с одиночными электронами впервые по: The experiment with single electrons was first performed and filmed by Merli, Missiroli and Pozzi in Bologna in 1974 (instead of slits they used an electron biprism; the effect is the same). In 1989 Tonomura showed how the pattern builds up from individual dots. In 2002 readers of Physics World named this experiment the most beautiful in the history of physics
Интерферируют не только электроны: нейтр: It is not only electrons that interfere: so do neutrons, atoms, molecules of fullerene C60 (Arndt and Zeilinger, 1999) and even molecules of almost 2,000 atoms (2019)
Полосы пропадают не потому, что кто-то с: The fringes disappear not because someone is looking but because the electron’s path has left a trace in the apparatus. As soon as the information about the slit is, in principle, recorded somewhere, the waves from the two slits stop adding up; this is called decoherence. The experimenter’s consciousness plays no part in it

Over a few tens of millions of years the Earth gathered out of this swarm.\n\nThe young planet was red-hot: impacts and the decay of radioactive elements melted it, and heavy iron sank to the center to form the core. This core still creates the magnetic field that protects life from the solar wind.

Ведущая гипотеза: вскоре после рождения: The leading hypothesis: soon after the Earth was born, a Mars-sized body struck it a glancing blow. Molten debris was thrown into orbit, and in a short time the Moon gathered out of it.\n\nThe Moon stabilizes the tilt of the Earth’s axis, and with it the climate. Its tides may have helped the first chemical reactions of life on the shores. At first the Moon was many times closer, and a day on Earth lasted only a few hours; since then it has been moving away, now at 3.8 cm a year.

Крошечные кристаллы циркона хранят весть: Tiny zircon crystals carry a message: just 150 million years in, the Earth already had water and crust.
В горах Джек-Хиллс в Австралии нашли кри: In the Jack Hills of Australia, zircon crystals 4.4 billion years old were found, the oldest known minerals on Earth. Their composition says they grew in the presence of liquid water and in rock resembling continental crust.\n\nSo the “hellish” era of a red-hot Earth was shorter than once thought: oceans may have appeared very early. Water could have come both from the planet’s own material and with asteroids and comets.

Образцы, привезённые «Аполлонами», показ: Samples brought back by the Apollo missions showed that many lunar basins solidified about 3.9 billion years ago. This gave rise to the idea of a “late heavy bombardment”, a wave of impacts caused by a rearrangement of the giant planets’ orbits.\n\nToday many scientists think there was no “wave”, and the impact rate simply declined smoothly. Either way, the Moon, which has neither wind nor water, has kept a record of that era that was erased on Earth.

Как неживая химия стала жизнью — одна из: How nonliving chemistry became life is one of the great mysteries of science. Possible places are hot springs on the ocean floor or shallow pools on land, where molecules were alternately dried and wetted. According to the popular “RNA world” hypothesis, the first molecules could both store information and speed up reactions.\n\nAll living things today, from a bacterium to a whale, use the same genetic code. So we all had a common ancestor, known as LUCA.
Надёжные следы жизни — строматолиты возр: Reliable traces of life are stromatolites about 3.5 billion years old (Pilbara, Australia)

Метка стоит на 3,8 млрд лет — посередине: The marker is set at 3.8 billion years, in the middle of this range
Почти во всех мифах творения жизнь выход: In almost every creation myth, life comes out of water: “Let the waters bring forth…” (Genesis)
Даосизм: вода — образ Дао, мягкая и дающ: Taoism: water is an image of the Tao, soft and giving life to all things
Цианобактерии учатся расщеплять воду све: Cyanobacteria learn to split water with light, and oxygen comes out as a by-product.
Первые фотосинтезирующие микробы использ: The first photosynthetic microbes used hydrogen sulfide or iron. Cyanobacteria found a source that the Earth has in endless supply: water. Splitting it with the energy of light, they released oxygen.\n\nCyanobacteria built stromatolites, layered limestone “cushions” that still grow in Shark Bay in Australia. Later one such bacterium settled inside another cell and became a chloroplast: every green leaf is a descendant of that alliance.
Время появления кислородного фотосинтеза: The appearance of oxygenic photosynthesis is dated from 2.7 to 3.0 billion years ago or earlier; estimates are disputed
Кислород цианобактерий наполняет атмосфе: Oxygen from cyanobacteria fills the atmosphere: poison for many microbes, breath for future animals.
Сотни миллионов лет кислород цианобактер: For hundreds of millions of years the cyanobacteria’s oxygen was used up oxidizing iron: red banded iron formations were laid down in the oceans, and we still mine them today. Once these “sponges” were saturated, oxygen began to build up in the air.\n\nThis was the first ecological catastrophe: many ancient microbes for which oxygen is poisonous died out or retreated to oxygen-free niches. The drop in greenhouse methane may have triggered one of the first global glaciations.
Великое кислородное событие — 2,4–2,1 мл: The Great Oxidation Event: 2.4–2.1 billion years ago
Полосчатые железные руды — главный источ: Banded iron formations are humanity’s main source of iron
Прана в йоге, ци в даосизме, пневма у гр: Prana in yoga, qi in Taoism, pneuma among the Greeks: the “breath of life”. In the language of science, we breathe a gift from cyanobacteria
Пять медленных вдохов, вспоминая, что ки: Take five slow breaths, remembering that their oxygen was breathed out by green beings, from ancient bacteria to the trees outside your window.
Одна клетка поселяется в другой и станов: One cell settles inside another and becomes a mitochondrion: this is how eukaryotes arise.
Бактерии просты: их ДНК плавает свободно: Bacteria are simple: their DNA floats freely. Eukaryotes (plants, fungi, animals) have a nucleus and “power plants”, the mitochondria. Lynn Margulis insisted that mitochondria were once free-living bacteria that another cell swallowed and did not digest.\n\nThe alliance benefited both. The energy of mitochondria allowed cells to become thousands of times larger and more complex. Mitochondria still have their own small DNA, a memory of their independent past.
Митохондрии — потомки свободноживущих ба: Mitochondria descend from free-living bacteria (the endosymbiotic theory, Lynn Margulis, 1967)
Время появления эукариот — 1,6–2,1 млрд: Eukaryotes appeared 1.6–2.1 billion years ago; estimates differ
Почти миллиард лет атмосфера, климат и ж: For almost a billion years the atmosphere, climate and life on Earth change surprisingly little.
Между 1,8 и 0,8 млрд лет назад геологи н: Between 1.8 and 0.8 billion years ago geologists find neither glaciations nor sharp jumps in oxygen, so the era was jokingly nicknamed the “Boring Billion”.\n\nBut important work was going on beneath the surface: the supercontinent Rodinia came together and broke apart, and eukaryotes were mastering sexual reproduction and multicellularity. Slow times can also be times of ripening.
Относительная стабильность среды 1,8–0,8: The relative stability of the environment 1.8–0.8 billion years ago is confirmed by geochemistry
Почему кислорода оставалось мало — обсуж: Why oxygen stayed low is debated
Красная водоросль Bangiomorpha — одно из: The red alga Bangiomorpha is one of the first multicellular organisms with sexual reproduction.
В скалах арктической Канады нашли нитчат: In the rocks of Arctic Canada, filamentous algae about a billion years old were found, resembling today’s red algae. They already had specialized cells and signs of sexual reproduction.\n\nSexual reproduction mixes the genes of two parents, and the offspring are more diverse, so evolution goes faster. Multicellularity arose independently many times: in algae, fungi and animals.
Возраст окаменелостей Bangiomorpha pubes: The fossils of Bangiomorpha pubescens are about 1.05 billion years old
Многоклеточность возникала независимо не: Multicellularity arose independently at least 25 times

В криогении Земля дважды покрывалась льд: In the Cryogenian the Earth was twice covered almost entirely by ice: the Sturtian glaciation (≈717–660 million years ago) and the Marinoan (≈650–635). The ice reflected sunlight, cooling the planet even further.\n\nVolcanoes helped it escape: carbon dioxide built up in the atmosphere until the greenhouse effect melted the ice. Life survived the glaciations in cracks, at hot springs and under thin ice, and soon after them the first large animals appeared.
Следы ледников на древних тропических ши: Traces of glaciers at ancient tropical latitudes are the main argument for the Snowball Earth hypothesis
Был ли океан замёрзшим полностью или ост: Whether the ocean froze completely or open patches of water remained (a “slushball”) is debated
Первые крупные животные: мягкие диски и: The first large animals: soft disks and “fronds” on the ocean floor.
Около 575 млн лет назад на морском дне п: About 575 million years ago strange creatures without shells, mouths or eyes appeared on the seafloor: the Ediacaran biota. For a long time it was debated whether they were animals at all.\n\nIn 2018 traces of cholesterol, a molecule typical of animals, were found in Dickinsonia fossils from the White Sea. So the 558-million-year-old Dickinsonia became one of the oldest reliably known animals. The world of the Ediacaran “mattresses” quietly vanished before the Cambrian explosion.

Родство многих эдиакарских форм с соврем: The relationship of many Ediacaran forms to modern animals is unclear
За 20–25 млн лет появляются почти все ос: Within 20–25 million years almost all the main animal body plans appear: eyes, armor, predators and prey.
В начале кембрия в летописи окаменелосте: At the start of the Cambrian, literally everything appears in the fossil record: arthropods, mollusks, echinoderms, the first chordates — our ancestors. Animals acquired shells and armor, and with them hard parts that preserve well.\n\nThe causes are sought in a combination of factors: rising oxygen, the appearance of eyes and predators, an arms race between hunters and prey. The “explosion” lasted millions of years, but by geological standards that is an instant.
Начало кембрийского периода — 538,8 млн: The beginning of the Cambrian period: 538.8 million years ago
Причины взрыва — несколько конкурирующих: The causes of the explosion: several competing explanations
Подводный оползень в Канаде сохранил мяг: An underwater landslide in Canada preserved the soft bodies of Cambrian animals: a window into an ancient ocean.
В 1909 году Чарльз Уолкотт нашёл в Скали: In 1909 Charles Walcott found shale in the Rocky Mountains with impressions of creatures whose soft tissues were preserved too. Among them are the five-eyed Opabinia, the predator Anomalocaris up to half a meter long, and Pikaia, which resembles early chordates.\n\nThe Burgess Shale and China’s Chengjiang showed how bizarre the Cambrian world was: many forms left no descendants, and some turned out to be branches of our own tree.
Возраст сланцев Бёрджес — около 508 млн: The Burgess Shale is about 508 million years old
Первые растения выходят из воды, следом: The first plants come out of the water, followed by fungi and arthropods. The land begins to turn green.
Сушу освоили потомки зелёных водорослей: The land was colonized by descendants of green algae resembling today’s liverworts and mosses. They had to solve new problems: not drying out, standing upright, getting water from the soil. Fungi helped: their threads grew together with roots, and this alliance, mycorrhiza, is still found in most plants.\n\nPlants changed the planet: they began to create soil, draw carbon dioxide from the air and change the climate.
Древнейшие споры наземных растений — око: The oldest spores of land plants are about 470 million years old
Микориза — союз грибов и корней — есть п: Mycorrhiza, the alliance of fungi and roots, is found in roughly 80–90% of plant species
Первое из «большой пятёрки»: оледенение: The first of the “Big Five”: glaciation and falling sea levels kill most marine species.
Жизнь в ордовике была почти вся морской: Life in the Ordovician was almost entirely marine, and very rich: reefs, trilobites, nautiloids. When the supercontinent Gondwana drifted toward the South Pole, glaciation began, sea levels fell and the shallows dried up.\n\nAbout 85% of marine species died. This is the first of the five mass extinctions, and each of them cleared space for new groups.
Ордовикско-силурийское вымирание — около: The Ordovician–Silurian extinction: about 445–443 million years ago; ≈85% of species disappeared
Рыбы обзаводятся челюстями — из жаберных: Fish acquire jaws: a new way of eating, and later of speaking, grows out of the gill arches.
Первые позвоночные — бесчелюстные рыбы —: The first vertebrates, jawless fish, sucked in their food. Jaws grew from the front gill arches and opened the way to hunting large prey.\n\nIn 2022 a “spiny shark”, Fanjingshania, 439 million years old, was described in China: the oldest undoubted jawed vertebrate. Our own jaws, teeth and even the small bones of the middle ear are descendants of those ancient arches.
Косточки среднего уха млекопитающих прои: The middle-ear bones of mammals evolved from bones of the jaw joint
Появляются насекомые — позже они первыми: Insects appear; later they will be the first to take to the air.
Древнейшее известное насекомое — Rhyniog: The oldest known insect is Rhyniognatha, from Scottish chert about 400 million years old. Insects were the first animals to fly, long before pterosaurs and birds.\n\nToday there are more than a million described insect species, more than all other animals combined. Without pollinators most flowering plants, and a large part of our food, would not exist.
Описано больше 1 млн видов насекомых; оц: More than 1 million insect species have been described; estimates of the total run up to 5.5 million
Деревья с настоящими корнями поднимаются: Trees with true roots rise tens of meters high: the land is covered with forest.
В карьере у города Каир в штате Нью-Йорк: In a quarry near the town of Cairo, New York, the fossilized root system of a forest about 386 million years old was found, the oldest known. Among its trees was Archaeopteris, which already had deep, branching roots similar to those of modern trees.\n\nForests changed soils and climate: they drew a lot of carbon dioxide out of the atmosphere, and the nutrients they washed into the seas may have caused algal blooms and oxygen-free zones in the ocean.
Ископаемый лес в Каире (Нью-Йорк) — окол: The fossil forest at Cairo (New York): about 386 million years (2019)
Связь распространения лесов с девонскими: The link between the spread of forests and the Devonian extinctions is a hypothesis

Тиктаалик — существо между рыбой и четве: Tiktaalik is a creature between fish and four-legged animal: it had gills and scales, but a flat head with a mobile neck and fins with “shoulder” and “wrist” bones. The paleontologist Neil Shubin predicted in advance in rocks of what age to look for such a transitional form, and found it in the Canadian Arctic.\n\nOur hands are remodeled fins: the same plan of “one bone, two bones, many little bones”.
Тиктаалик — переходная форма между рыбам: Tiktaalik is a transitional form between fish and tetrapods, 375 million years old (Shubin et al., 2006)
Следы четвероногих из Польши — около 395: Tetrapod tracks from Poland are about 395 million years old: the move onto land began even earlier
Второе массовое вымирание: в океанах исч: The second mass extinction: reefs and many fish vanish from the oceans.
В позднем девоне жизнь пережила серию кр: In the Late Devonian, life went through a series of crises. Warm shallow seas suffered most: huge reefs disappeared, along with most armored fish and trilobites.\n\nThe causes were oxygen-free water in the ocean, climate swings and possibly volcanism. The freed space was taken by new groups of fish and the first tetrapods.
Позднедевонское вымирание — около 372 мл: The Late Devonian extinction: about 372 million years ago (the Kellwasser event)
Главная причина не установлена: The main cause has not been established
Болотные леса из гигантских плаунов и хв: Swamp forests of giant clubmosses and horsetails; there is so much oxygen in the air that dragonflies grow up to 70 cm.
В каменноугольном периоде тропики покрыв: In the Carboniferous period the tropics were covered with swampy forests of clubmoss trees up to 40 meters tall. Dead trunks fell into the water and did not have time to rot, and over millions of years layers built up that became coal.\n\nThe air was about 30% oxygen (today 21%), and arthropods reached unprecedented sizes: the millipede Arthropleura more than two meters long, Meganeura dragonflies with wingspans up to 70 cm. The coal humanity burned in the industrial age is the sunlight of those forests.
Каменноугольный период — 359–299 млн лет: The Carboniferous period: 359–299 million years ago
Концентрация кислорода до ≈ 30% — оценка: Oxygen concentration up to ≈30% is a model estimate
Появляются амниоты — их яйцо не высыхает: Amniotes appear: their eggs do not dry out, and vertebrates leave the water for good.
Амфибии и сегодня откладывают икру в вод: Amphibians still lay their eggs in water today. Amniotes invented an egg with membranes and a supply of water inside, a little “pond” of its own. Now it was possible to live far from water.\n\nTwo branches arose from the early amniotes: one led to reptiles, dinosaurs and birds, the other to mammals. The oldest known amniote is Hylonomus, from fossilized tree stumps in Nova Scotia.
Все материки соединяются в один суперкон: All the continents join into one supercontinent surrounded by the ocean Panthalassa.
Материки дрейфуют — это доказали только: The continents drift; this was proved only in the mid-20th century, although as early as 1912 Alfred Wegener noticed that the coasts of Africa and South America fit together like puzzle pieces.\n\nPangaea came together about 300 million years ago and began to break apart about 200 million years ago. Inside the huge continent the climate was very dry. In 200–250 million years, calculations say, the continents will come together again into a new supercontinent.
Тектоника плит — основа современной геол: Plate tectonics is the foundation of modern geology; the continents move a few centimeters a year
Будущий суперконтинент (Пангея Ультима,: A future supercontinent (Pangaea Ultima, Amasia): model scenarios
Извержения Сибирских траппов, потепление: Eruptions of the Siberian Traps, warming and ocean acidification: most marine species disappear.
Самая страшная катастрофа в истории жизн: The worst catastrophe in the history of life. In Siberia, lava poured out for hundreds of thousands of years, covering millions of square kilometers. The volcanoes released huge amounts of carbon dioxide: warming, acidification and loss of oxygen in the ocean made the water deadly.\n\nThe last trilobites disappeared, along with most of the reptile-like forerunners of mammals. Life needed about 10 million years to recover, and in the new world the dinosaurs rose.
Пермско-триасовое вымирание — 251,9 млн: The Permian–Triassic extinction: 251.9 million years ago, the largest of the five mass extinctions
Доля исчезнувших морских видов — по разн: The share of marine species lost: from 80 to 96%, according to different estimates
Шива-Натараджа танцует разрушение, без к: Shiva Nataraja dances the destruction without which there is no renewal
Стоики — экпироза: мировой огонь, после: The Stoics — ekpyrosis: a world fire after which the world is born anew
Появляются динозавры; вскоре они займут: Dinosaurs appear; soon they will take over the land and rule it for about 165 million years.
Первые динозавры были небольшими двуноги: The first dinosaurs were small two-legged predators the size of a dog. Their advantage was legs set straight under the body like columns and, probably, a fast metabolism.\n\nAfter the Triassic extinction they filled every niche on land: from giant sauropods more than 30 meters long to small feathered hunters. Many dinosaurs were covered in feathers, as finds in China have shown.
Древнейшие несомненные динозавры — около: The oldest undoubted dinosaurs are about 233–230 million years old (Argentina, Brazil)
Перья были у многих групп динозавров, не: Many groups of dinosaurs had feathers, not only birds
Рядом с динозаврами живут маленькие ночн: Alongside the dinosaurs live small nocturnal animals: the first mammals.
Наши предки 150 млн лет прятались в тени: For 150 million years our ancestors hid in the shadow of the dinosaurs. They were the size of a mouse and lived at night, which may explain warm blood, fur, keen hearing and smell.\n\nThe main invention of mammals is milk: a mother’s care for her young gave the brain time to grow and learn. Many features of our perception, for example the fact that most mammals see red poorly, are a legacy of that nocturnal era.
Ранние млекопитающие и маммалиаформы — 2: Early mammals and mammaliaforms: 225–200 million years ago; the boundary of the group is drawn in different ways
Распад Пангеи и извержения открывают эру: The breakup of Pangaea and its eruptions open the era of the dinosaurs.
Когда Пангея начала раскалываться, вдоль: When Pangaea began to split, enormous masses of lava poured out along the future Atlantic Ocean. The climate warmed sharply, and the ocean acidified.\n\nMany large relatives of crocodiles that competed with the dinosaurs disappeared. The dinosaurs survived, and in the Jurassic they became the masters of the land.
Триасово-юрское вымирание — 201,4 млн ле: The Triassic–Jurassic extinction: 201.4 million years ago; linked to the Central Atlantic Magmatic Province
Перья, крылья, зубы и длинный хвост — пт: Feathers, wings, teeth and a long tail: bird and dinosaur in one body.
В 1861 году, всего через два года после: In 1861, just two years after Darwin’s “On the Origin of Species”, Archaeopteryx was found in Bavaria: a creature with feathers and wings, but with teeth, claws on its fingers and a long bony tail. It became a famous proof of evolution.\n\nToday it is clear that birds are living dinosaurs, a branch of small feathered predators. And Tyrannosaurus itself lived closer in time to us than to Stegosaurus.
Птицы — потомки тероподных динозавров: Birds are descendants of theropod dinosaurs
Появляются цветковые растения — и мир ок: Flowering plants appear, and the world takes on color.
Дарвин называл быстрое появление цветков: Darwin called the rapid appearance of flowering plants an “abominable mystery”. A flower is an alliance with animals: the plant pays with nectar for carrying pollen, and with fruit for spreading seeds.\n\nToday there are about 300,000 species of flowering plants, almost all the plants around us, including the cereals that feed humanity. One of the oldest is the aquatic plant Montsechia from Spain, about 130 million years old.
Время возникновения цветковых по молекул: Molecular clocks date the origin of flowering plants earlier than the fossils do; the question is open
Астероид поперечником около 10 км падает: An asteroid about 10 km across falls near the Yucatán Peninsula, and the world passes to mammals and birds.
В 1980 году отец и сын Альваресы нашли п: In 1980 the Alvarezes, father and son, found a thin layer of clay all over the world rich in iridium, an element rare on Earth and common in asteroids. Later the Chicxulub crater, 180 km across, was found off the coast of Mexico.\n\nThe impact raised dust and soot that blotted out the Sun for months; food chains collapsed. The non-avian dinosaurs, the ammonites and about three quarters of all species disappeared. The small and the omnivorous survived, among them our ancestors.

На деревьях появляются маленькие приматы: Small primates appear in the trees: grasping hands, forward-facing eyes, a large brain.

Life in the branches demanded gripping hands with nails and precise judgment of distance: the eyes moved forward, giving depth perception.\n\nLater primates learned to tell red from green, which is handy for finding ripe fruit and young leaves. Our hands and our gaze are a gift of ancient forests.

Palms grew beyond the Arctic Circle, and the ocean acidified.\n\nScientists study this era as a clue to the future: back then the release was slower than today’s release from humanity’s burning of fuel.

Within 10–15 million years its descendants lost their hind legs and became giants of the sea.\n\nThe closest living relatives of whales are hippos. The pelvic bones that whales still have are a memory of life on land.

Антарктида уходит от других материков и: Antarctica moves away from the other continents and is covered by an ice sheet.
Когда Антарктида отделилась от Австралии: When Antarctica separated from Australia and South America, a cold current arose around it and cut it off from warmth. There was less carbon dioxide in the air, and an ice sheet grew on the continent.\n\nSince then the Earth has been in a “cool” mode. Antarctic ice holds air bubbles up to 800,000 years old, which are used to reconstruct ancient climate.
Оледенение Антарктиды началось около 34: The glaciation of Antarctica began about 34 million years ago (at the Eocene–Oligocene boundary)
Расходятся мартышки и человекообразные —: Monkeys and apes part ways, and our branch loses its tail.
Около 25 млн лет назад линия человекообр: About 25 million years ago the ape lineage split off from the Old World monkeys. The tail disappeared, the chest became broad and the shoulders mobile: it became possible to hang and swing from branches.\n\nIn 2024 it was found that the loss of the tail may have been caused by the insertion of a single “jumping gene” into the TBXT gene of our ancestors. Today the apes are gibbons, orangutans, gorillas, chimpanzees, bonobos and us.

ДНК человека и шимпанзе совпадает пример: Human and chimpanzee DNA is about 98–99% identical. Somewhere in Africa, 6–8 million years ago, lived a population from which both lineages descend.\n\nOne of the oldest candidates on our branch is Sahelanthropus from Chad, about 7 million years old: it had small canines and possibly walked upright. The main difference between early hominins and apes is not the brain but walking on two legs.

Then the Atlantic broke through at Gibraltar.\n\nAccording to one model, the flow was a thousand times more powerful than the Amazon, and the sea filled in anything from a few months to two years. It sounds like a flood myth, but 5 million years before humans.

Ардипитек: ходит на двух ногах по земле,: Ardipithecus: walks on two legs on the ground but climbs trees with a grasping foot.
Скелет «Арди» из Эфиопии собирали 15 лет: The skeleton of “Ardi” from Ethiopia took 15 years to piece together. She was a female about 120 cm tall who lived 4.4 million years ago in wooded country. Her foot still had a big toe set apart for climbing, but her pelvis was already adapted for walking.\n\nArdi disproved the idea that upright walking was born only on the open savanna: our ancestors began to walk while still in the forest.
В вулканическом пепле Танзании застыли с: The footprints of two upright-walking creatures froze in the volcanic ash of Tanzania.
В 1978 году команда Мэри Лики нашла цепо: In 1978 Mary Leakey’s team found a trail of footprints about 27 meters long. A volcano covered the ground with ash, it rained, hominins walked across the wet ash, and the prints turned to stone.\n\nThe prints are strikingly like ours: an arch to the foot, a big toe next to the others. They are 3.66 million years old, the oldest direct evidence of a gait like ours.
Следы в Лаэтоли — 3,66 млн лет; оставлен: The Laetoli footprints: 3.66 million years; probably left by Australopithecus afarensis
Кто-то в Кении начинает раскалывать камн: Someone in Kenya begins to split stones: tools older than our genus.
У озера Туркана, в местечке Ломекви, наш: By Lake Turkana, at a site called Lomekwi, stone flakes and cores 3.3 million years old were found. That is 700,000 years earlier than was thought, and earlier than the oldest known members of the genus Homo.\n\nSo tools were made by australopithecines or their relatives. A stone in the hand changed the diet, making meat and bone marrow available, and the diet may have changed the brain.
Орудия Ломекви-3 — около 3,3 млн лет (Na: The Lomekwi 3 tools: about 3.3 million years (Nature, 2015)
Самый знаменитый скелет: австралопитек р: The most famous skeleton: an australopithecine just over a meter tall.
В 1974 году в Эфиопии нашли 40% скелета: In 1974, 40% of the skeleton of a young female australopithecine was found in Ethiopia. That evening the camp was playing the song “Lucy in the Sky with Diamonds”, and so she got her name. In Ethiopia she is called Dinkinesh, “you are marvelous”.\n\nLucy walked on two legs, but her brain was the size of a chimpanzee’s, about 400 cm³. So upright walking appeared long before a large brain.
Появляются первые представители нашего р: The first members of our genus appear.
Челюсть из Леди-Герару в Эфиопии — древн: The jaw from Ledi-Geraru in Ethiopia is the oldest known member of the genus Homo, about 2.8 million years old. At that time Africa’s climate was becoming drier, forests were retreating and savannas expanding.\n\nEarly Homo, such as Homo habilis, had brains larger than those of australopithecines and made stone tools systematically. An era began in which survival depended more and more on inventiveness.
Челюсть LD 350-1 из Леди-Герару — около: The LD 350-1 jaw from Ledi-Geraru: about 2.8 million years (Science, 2015)
Начинается четвертичный период: ледники: The Quaternary period begins: glaciers advance and retreat every 40,000–100,000 years.
Около 2,6 млн лет назад Земля вошла в ри: About 2.6 million years ago the Earth entered the rhythm of ice ages. The rhythm is set by slow variations in the orbit and the tilt of the axis: the Milankovitch cycles.\n\nIn the cold periods glaciers covered the north of Europe and America, and sea level fell by 120 meters. The whole making of humankind took place on this climate seesaw, and perhaps it was this that taught us to adapt.
Начало четвертичного периода — 2,58 млн: The beginning of the Quaternary period: 2.58 million years ago

Высокий, выносливый, с большим мозгом —: Tall, enduring, with a large brain, and the first to leave Africa.
Homo erectus был почти нашего роста и сл: Homo erectus was almost our height and build: long legs adapted to running long distances. It invented the hand axe, a symmetrical stone tool that was made almost unchanged for a million and a half years.\n\nHomo erectus was the first to leave Africa: skulls from Dmanisi in Georgia are about 1.8 million years old, tools from China about 2.1 million years. Its descendants survived on Java until 110,000 years ago.
Находки Дманиси (Грузия) — около 1,8 млн: The Dmanisi finds (Georgia): about 1.8 million years
Орудия из Шанчэня (Китай) — около 2,1 мл: The tools from Shangchen (China): about 2.1 million years; who made them is unknown
Человек приручает огонь: тепло, защита,: Humans tame fire: warmth, protection, cooked food, evenings by the fire.
В пещере Вондерверк в ЮАР нашли золу и о: In Wonderwerk Cave in South Africa, ash and burnt bones about a million years old were found, among the oldest traces of controlled fire.\n\nCooked food is easier to digest: the primatologist Richard Wrangham believes that cooking allowed the gut to shrink and a large brain to grow. And the evening fire lengthened the day: time for conversation, stories and perhaps the first myths.
Следы управляемого огня в пещере Вондерв: Traces of controlled fire in Wonderwerk Cave: about 1 million years; when fire became an everyday thing is disputed
«Кулинарная гипотеза» Рэнгема — влиятель: Wrangham’s “cooking hypothesis” is influential but not proven
Ригведа открывается словом «Агни»: огонь: The Rigveda opens with the word “Agni”: fire is the mediator between humans and gods
Прометей похищает огонь у богов и отдаёт: Prometheus steals fire from the gods and gives it to humans
Свеча: несколько минут смотреть на пламя: Candle gazing: look at a flame for a few minutes, then hold its image with your eyes closed (trataka).
В Европе живут неандертальцы — сильные,: Neanderthals live in Europe: strong, skilled, with brains no smaller than ours.
В испанской пещере Сима-де-лос-Уэсос («Я: In the Spanish cave of Sima de los Huesos (“Pit of Bones”), the remains of 28 people about 430,000 years old were found: early Neanderthals. Neanderthals lived in Ice Age Europe and Asia, hunted large animals, used fire, buried their dead and made ornaments.\n\nThey were not “savages”: most people of non-African descent carry 1–2% Neanderthal DNA. Our ancestors met them and had children together.
Сима-де-лос-Уэсос — около 430 тыс. лет;: Sima de los Huesos: about 430,000 years; DNA showed a kinship with Neanderthals
У неафриканцев ≈ 1–2% генома — неандерта: In non-Africans ≈1–2% of the genome is of Neanderthal origin (Pääbo, Nobel Prize 2022)
Появляется наш вид. Вся письменная истор: Our species appears. All of written history is still ahead: twelve minutes to midnight.
Находки из марокканской пещеры Джебель-И: Finds from the Moroccan cave of Jebel Irhoud, about 300,000 years old, showed that Homo sapiens took shape across all of Africa, not in a single “cradle”. The faces of early sapiens were already almost modern, and their skulls slightly more elongated.\n\nOther humans lived on the planet alongside us: Neanderthals, Denisovans, the tiny “hobbit” of the island of Flores. We are the last of many.
Находки из Джебель-Ирхуд (Марокко) — око: The finds from Jebel Irhoud (Morocco): about 300,000 years

Бытие: человек создан по образу и подоби: Genesis: humans are created in the image and likeness of God
Людей начинают хоронить — с охрой, раков: People begin to bury the dead, with ochre, shells and ornaments.
В пещерах Схул и Кафзех в Израиле нашли: In the caves of Skhul and Qafzeh in Israel, burials of anatomically modern humans about 100,000–120,000 years old were found, some with shells and ochre. Neanderthals buried their dead too.\n\nBurial is one of the first signs of symbolic thinking: death is no longer only the end of the body. We do not know what these people believed, but we see a care that reaches beyond life.
Погребения в Схуле и Кафзехе — около 100: The burials at Skhul and Qafzeh: about 100,000–120,000 years

В пещере Бломбос кто-то процарапал на ку: In Blombos Cave someone scratched a grid of lines onto a piece of ochre.
В южноафриканской пещере Бломбос нашли к: In Blombos Cave in South Africa, a piece of ochre with an engraved geometric pattern about 75,000 years old was found, and next to it shell beads. Later an ochre drawing on stone 73,000 years old was found there as well, the oldest known drawing.\n\nThe pattern does not “do” anything: it means something. This is the frontier where a world of signs appears among humans.

Небольшие группы сапиенсов выходят из Аф: Small groups of sapiens leave Africa; their descendants will settle the whole world.
Сапиенсы выходили из Африки не раз, но г: Sapiens left Africa more than once, but the main wave, from which almost all non-Africans descend, was about 70,000–50,000 years ago. People moved along the coasts, following the shore of the Indian Ocean.\n\nGenetics shows a “bottleneck”: all non-Africans descend from a relatively small group. Genetically, any two people on Earth are closer to each other than two groups of chimpanzees from neighboring forests.

Генетическое разнообразие людей вне Афри: The genetic diversity of people outside Africa is a subset of Africa’s
Люди переплывают море и достигают Австра: People cross the sea and reach Australia: one of the first sea crossings.
Даже в ледниковые эпохи, когда уровень м: Even in the ice ages, when the sea level was low, straits up to 90 km wide remained between Asia and Australia. The first Australians crossed them on rafts or boats: this is the oldest evidence of seafaring.\n\nAboriginal Australians have one of the oldest continuous cultures on Earth. Their stories of the Dreaming have been passed down for tens of thousands of years.
Стоянка Маджедбебе — около 65 тыс. лет (: The Madjedbebe site: about 65,000 years (Nature, 2017); genetic estimates from 2025 give about 60,000 years, and the debate continues
Первые люди нашего вида приходят в Европ: The first people of our species come to Europe, the lands of the Neanderthals.
В пещере Мандрен на юге Франции нашли зу: In Mandrin Cave in southern France, a sapiens child’s tooth and small stone points about 54,000 years old were found, perhaps for bows and arrows. A few thousand years later Neanderthals lived in the same cave again.\n\nThis find showed that sapiens and Neanderthals lived as neighbors for centuries, taking turns, rather than one quick wave displacing the other.
Мандрен — около 54 тыс. лет (Science Adv: Mandrin: about 54,000 years (Science Advances, 2022); the dating is debated
На стене пещеры на Сулавеси — люди и сви: On a cave wall on Sulawesi, people and a pig: the oldest known scene with a story.
В пещере Леанг-Карампуанг на индонезийск: In the cave of Leang Karampuang on the Indonesian island of Sulawesi, a painting was found: three human-like figures next to a wild pig. It is at least 51,200 years old.\n\nThis is not just an image but a story. The ability to tell stories about what is not before our eyes may be the defining feature of our species.
Сулавеси, Индонезия: сцена с людьми и св: Sulawesi, Indonesia: a scene with people and a pig, at least 51,200 years old (Nature, 2024)
Во многих шаманских традициях пещера — в: In many shamanic traditions the cave is an entrance to another world. Some researchers see traces of altered states of consciousness in ancient paintings; this is a hypothesis, not a proven fact
Флейты из птичьих костей и бивня мамонта: Flutes of bird bone and mammoth ivory: the oldest musical instruments.
В пещерах Швабского Альба в Германии наш: In the caves of the Swabian Jura in Germany, flutes made of vulture and swan bone and of mammoth ivory, about 40,000–43,000 years old, were found. You can play a melody on them: some have five holes.\n\nThe oldest figurines were found there too: the “Venus of Hohle Fels” and the Lion Man. Music, art and probably ritual appeared almost at the same time.
Флейты из Гайсенклёстерле и Холе-Фельс —: The flutes from Geißenklösterle and Hohle Fels: about 40,000–43,000 years
Нада-йога: «Нада Брахма» — мир есть звук: Nada yoga: “Nada Brahma”, the world is sound
Послушать тишину минуту, затем одну ноту: Listen to silence for a minute, then to a single note, your own, sung, and then to silence again.
Неандертальцы исчезают — но их гены живу: The Neanderthals disappear, but their genes live on in us.
Около 40 тысяч лет назад неандертальцы к: About 40,000 years ago the Neanderthals disappeared as a separate population. There seem to have been several causes: small numbers, climate change, competition and interbreeding with sapiens.\n\nNeanderthal genes still help us today, for example in immunity and adaptation to cold, while some are linked to diseases. They did not die out completely: they dissolved into us.
Исчезновение неандертальцев — около 41–3: The disappearance of the Neanderthals: about 41,000–39,000 years ago
Главная причина исчезновения не установл: The main cause of their disappearance has not been established
Львы, носороги и лошади — живопись, дост: Lions, rhinoceroses and horses: painting worthy of Renaissance masters.
Пещеру Шове во Франции открыли в 1994 го: Chauvet Cave in France was discovered in 1994. On its walls are hundreds of animals: lions on the hunt, fighting rhinos, a herd of horses. The artists used the relief of the wall to make the figures look three-dimensional, and drew several heads in a row to convey movement, like in a cartoon.\n\nThe paintings are about 36,000 years old. Art did not “develop” from the primitive to the complex: it was mature from the very start.
Следы на берегу древнего озера в Нью-Мек: Footprints on the shore of an ancient lake in New Mexico: people were in the Americas 10,000 years earlier than thought.
Долго считалось, что люди пришли в Амери: It was long believed that people came to the Americas about 13,000 years ago. Footprints in White Sands National Park, where adults and children walked along a lakeshore, are dated to 23,000–21,000 years ago. So people were in the Americas at the height of the Ice Age.\n\nThe dating was challenged, but three independent methods have confirmed it. How and when exactly people crossed Beringia is an open question.
Следы Уайт-Сэндс — 23–21 тыс. лет; подтв: The White Sands footprints: 23,000–21,000 years; confirmed by independent methods (Science, 2023; 2025)
Последнее оледенение в разгаре: льды над: The last glaciation at its height: ice up to three kilometers thick over northern Europe.
21 тысячу лет назад ледники покрывали Ск: 21,000 years ago glaciers covered Scandinavia, Britain, northern Russia and Canada. The sea level was 120 meters lower: Britain was joined to Europe, and Asia to America.\n\nPeople lived in “refugia”, warm shelters in southern Europe, and hunted mammoths. When the ice retreated, new lands opened up before them.
Последний ледниковый максимум — около 26: The Last Glacial Maximum: about 26,000–19,000 years ago
«Сикстинская капелла первобытности»: бык: The “Sistine Chapel of prehistory”: bulls, deer and mysterious signs.
Пещеру Ласко нашли в 1940 году четверо п: Lascaux Cave was found in 1940 by four teenagers. On its walls are about 600 paintings and fifteen hundred engravings: huge bulls, horses, deer, and among them dots and grids whose meaning is unknown.\n\nThe original has been closed since 1963: visitors’ breath was destroying the paintings. Today visitors see exact replicas.
Волк становится собакой — первый одомашн: The wolf becomes the dog, the first domesticated species, long before farming.
Собака — единственное животное, одомашне: The dog is the only animal domesticated by hunter-gatherers. A 2026 study of ancient DNA found genetically confirmed dogs 15,800–14,300 years old in Britain, Turkey, Germany, Italy and Switzerland.\n\nIt seems that wolves themselves drew close to human camps for scraps of food, and people accepted the friendliest. Dogs learned to read our gaze and gestures like no other animal.
Древнейшие генетически подтверждённые со: The oldest genetically confirmed dogs: 15,800–14,300 years (Nature, 2026)

Охотники-собиратели строят каменные свят: Hunter-gatherers build stone sanctuaries, before farming and cities appeared.
На холме в Турции стоят круги из Т-образ: On a hill in Turkey stand circles of T-shaped pillars up to 5.5 meters tall, decorated with reliefs of foxes, snakes, boars and birds of prey. They are about 11,600 years old, six millennia older than Stonehenge.\n\nThe people who built them did not yet sow grain. Perhaps it was the other way around: first a sanctuary that brought people together, and then farming to feed them.
Гёбекли-Тепе — около 11,6 тыс. лет назад: Göbekli Tepe: about 11,600 years ago (≈9600 BCE)

На Ближнем Востоке начинают сеять пшениц: In the Middle East people begin to sow wheat and barley: the greatest change in human life.
В «Плодородном полумесяце» — от Египта д: In the “Fertile Crescent”, from Egypt to Mesopotamia, people domesticated wheat, barley, peas, goats and sheep. Farming arose independently in at least ten other places: rice and millet in China, maize in Mexico, potatoes in the Andes.\n\nFarming brought food surpluses, population growth, cities and writing, but also hard labor, inequality and diseases from livestock. The historian Yuval Harari called it “history’s biggest fraud”: did people domesticate wheat, or did wheat domesticate people?
Одомашнивание растений на Ближнем Восток: The domestication of plants in the Middle East: about 11,000–10,000 years ago
Земледелие возникло независимо не меньше: Farming arose independently in at least 11 regions
Деметра и Персефона: миф о зерне, которо: Demeter and Persephone: the myth of the grain that goes under the earth and returns; the Eleusinian Mysteries were built on it
Один из первых больших посёлков: тысячи: One of the first large settlements: thousands of people, houses wall to wall, entrances through the roofs.
В Анатолии 9400 лет назад вырос посёлок: In Anatolia 9,400 years ago a settlement of 3,000–8,000 people grew up. There were no streets: the houses stood wall to wall, and people walked across the roofs. Inside the houses were wall paintings, bull horns set into the walls and burials under the floor.\n\nSurprisingly, there are almost no signs of strong inequality: the houses are much alike. Early settlements may have been organized differently from how we are used to thinking about “civilization”.
Люди учатся выплавлять медь из руды — на: People learn to smelt copper from ore: the age of metals begins.
Древнейшие следы выплавки меди — на Балк: The oldest traces of copper smelting are in the Balkans, at Belovode in Serbia, about 7,000 years ago. Later, by alloying copper with tin, people made bronze, harder and stronger.\n\nMetal changed everything: tools, weapons, long-distance trade (tin and copper are rarely found together), and with them power and war.
Выплавка меди в Беловоде (Сербия) — окол: Copper smelting at Belovode (Serbia): about 5000 BCE

Today, because of their overuse, bacteria are developing resistance, one of the main threats to health.

В 1924 году Эдвин Хаббл доказал, что тум: In 1924 Edwin Hubble proved that the Andromeda Nebula is a separate galaxy far beyond the Milky Way. The Universe grew millions of times larger in the human imagination.\n\nIn 1929 he showed that the farther away a galaxy is, the faster it recedes. Even earlier, Alexander Friedmann (1922) and Georges Lemaître (1927) had derived this from Einstein’s equations. Hence the idea of the Big Bang.

В 1953 году Джеймс Уотсон и Фрэнсис Крик: In 1953 James Watson and Francis Crick proposed a model of DNA: a double helix in which two strands are joined by base pairs. On April 12, 1961, Yuri Gagarin made the first human spaceflight aboard Vostok 1: one orbit of the Earth in 108 minutes. “Poyekhali!” (“Let’s go!”), he said at launch.\n\nThe space age began as a rivalry between two powers, but it gave us a shared view of the Earth from outside.
Снимок «Аполлона-8»: голубая Земля над л: The Apollo 8 photograph: the blue Earth above the lunar horizon.
24 декабря 1968 года астронавт Уильям Ан: On December 24, 1968, the astronaut William Anders photographed the Earth rising over the Moon. Many believe this picture helped give birth to the environmental movement.
«Эффект обзора» (Фрэнк Уайт, 1987): мног: The “overview effect” (Frank White, 1987): many astronauts, on seeing the whole Earth, described a sense of the unity and fragility of the world

Their footprints on the Moon, where there is neither wind nor rain, will last for millions of years.

On the calendar a day of Brahma begins at almost the same time as the Earth forms. This is a coincidence of numbers, not a dating: the tradition does not link the kalpa to the birth of the planet. The whole “life of Brahma”, 311 trillion years, does not fit into this year.

By the traditional count the Kali Yuga began in 3102 BCE and will last more than 400,000 years more. Hesiod has a similar ladder of decline: the golden, silver, bronze, heroic and iron ages. The dates of the yugas are a symbolic chronology, not a geological one.

Plato in the “Timaeus” spoke of a “perfect year” when all the heavenly bodies return to their places; later it was linked to precession and the zodiacal “ages”, and that is already tradition. On the calendar the Great Year takes up almost the whole last minute.
Эра в 13 бактунов — 1 872 000 дней, ≈ 51: An era of 13 baktuns is 1,872,000 days, ≈5,125 years: from August 11, 3114 BCE, to December 21, 2012. The calendar itself is real and precise; the “end of the world in 2012” is a modern myth, for the Maya it was the change of an era. The start of the Maya era and the start of the Kali Yuga are only 12 years apart: an independent and curious coincidence.
The dark age: by tradition (Aryabhata, 5th century) it began in 3102 BCE. In the last minute of the calendar its beginning stands next to the appearance of writing.

In the number of species and the variety of their chemistry they surpass all other groups combined. Цианобактерии, или сине-зелёные водоросл: Cyanobacteria, or blue-green algae, split water with the energy of light and release oxygen. About 2.4 billion years ago they changed the planet’s atmosphere.\n\nOne cyanobacterium once settled inside a eukaryotic cell and became a chloroplast, which is why every green leaf carries a descendant of these microbes. Хлоропласты растений и водорослей происх: The chloroplasts of plants and algae descend from cyanobacteria

Протеобактерии (псевдомонадоты) — кишечн: Proteobacteria (Pseudomonadota) include E. coli, nitrogen-fixing root-nodule bacteria and salmonella. Второй домен безъядерных клеток — внешне: The second domain of cells without a nucleus: outwardly like bacteria, but closer to us in their molecules.

According to current data, we eukaryotes grew out of a branch of the archaea.
Домен архей выделен Карлом Вёзе в 1977–1: The archaeal domain was defined by Carl Woese in 1977–1990 from ribosomal RNA sequences
Происхождение эукариот изнутри архей (дв: The origin of eukaryotes from within the archaea (the two-domain tree) is the leading but not final hypothesis
Археи, выдыхающие метан: в болотах, рисо: Archaea that breathe out methane: in swamps, rice paddies and the stomachs of cows.

A cow’s burp is the work of the methanogens in its rumen.\n\nIn the early atmosphere, poor in oxygen, their methane may have kept the planet warm when the Sun shone more faintly.
