Археи, названные в честь Асгарда, — ближ: Archaea named after Asgard: the closest known relatives of eukaryotes.
В 2015 году в донных осадках у гидротерм: In 2015, in seabed sediments near the hydrothermal vent “Loki’s Castle”, the DNA of unknown archaea was found; they were named Lokiarchaeota, and the whole group Asgard archaea. Their genomes contain genes thought to be “purely eukaryotic”: proteins of the cytoskeleton and of membrane vesicles.\n\nIn 2020 Japanese scientists, after 12 years of trying, grew one of these archaea in the lab. It turned out to have long tentacles; perhaps it used them to embrace the future mitochondrion.
Асгардархеи открыты по ДНК в 2015 году;: Asgard archaea were discovered from DNA in 2015; the first cultivated representative was described in Nature in 2020
Эукариоты, вероятно, произошли изнутри а: Eukaryotes probably arose from within the Asgard archaea: this is the leading hypothesis
Даосизм: из союза двух рождается третье: Taoism: from the union of two a third is born, something new that was in neither of them
Клетки с ядром и митохондриями — союз ар: Cells with a nucleus and mitochondria: an alliance of an archaeon and a bacterium, from which all complex forms of life grew.
Эукариотная клетка в среднем в тысячи ра: A eukaryotic cell is on average thousands of times larger in volume than a bacterium. It has a nucleus that stores DNA, mitochondria that produce energy, internal membranes and a “skeleton” of protein filaments.\n\nIt all began with an alliance: an archaeon swallowed a bacterium, and the bacterium became a mitochondrion. The energy of mitochondria allowed cells to have huge genomes and complex structures. From eukaryotes came plants, fungi, animals and a multitude of single-celled organisms.
Митохондрии — потомки бактерий, у них св: Mitochondria are descendants of bacteria and have their own DNA
Ядро, митохондрии (митохондриальная ДНК: The nucleus, mitochondria (mitochondrial DNA comes to us only through the maternal line), sexual reproduction with meiosis.
Амёбы и слизевики — одноклеточные, умеющ: Amoebas and slime molds: single cells that can gather into a “creature”.
Слизевик физарум — одна гигантская клетк: The slime mold Physarum, a single giant cell with many nuclei, can find the shortest path to food through a maze. In 2010 Japanese scientists placed oat flakes where the cities around Tokyo are, and the slime mold laid out a network resembling the real railway.\n\nIt has no nervous system, but it has behavior: a good reason to think about the nature of “mind”.
Слизевик воспроизвёл сеть железных дорог: A slime mold reproduced the Tokyo rail network (Tero et al., Science, 2010)
Огромная группа одноклеточных и водоросл: A huge group of single-celled organisms and algae: diatoms, brown algae, ciliates, foraminifera.
Название SAR — по первым буквам трёх вет: The name SAR comes from the first letters of three branches: stramenopiles, alveolates, rhizarians. It includes giant brown algae, kelp up to 50 meters long, as well as the malaria parasite Plasmodium and the slipper animalcule Paramecium.\n\nThis group shows that “algae” is not a kinship but a way of life: brown algae are closer to the malaria parasite than to green plants.
Бурые водоросли эволюционно далеки от зе: Brown algae are evolutionarily distant from green plants: they acquired their chloroplasts secondarily, by engulfing a red alga
Инфузории: одна клетка — два ядра, тысяч: Ciliates: one cell, two nuclei, thousands of cilia and almost “animal behavior”.
Инфузория-туфелька плавает, работая тыся: Paramecium swims by beating thousands of cilia, avoids obstacles and eats bacteria through a “mouth”. It has two nuclei: the large one runs the life of the cell, the small one keeps the genes for reproduction.\n\nSome ciliates can learn the simplest responses; this is discussed as “intelligence without neurons”.
Привыкание у одноклеточных показано в ря: Habituation in single-celled organisms has been shown in a number of experiments, but how far it counts as “learning” is debated
Одноклеточные в раковинах — из их скелет: Single-celled organisms in shells: mountains are built from their skeletons.
Фораминиферы строят известковые раковинк: Foraminifera build chambered limestone shells. Over hundreds of millions of years their skeletons settled on the seafloor as thick layers of limestone. The pyramids of Giza are built of nummulitic limestone, made of foraminifera shells.\n\nFrom the composition of their shells geologists reconstruct the temperature of ancient oceans.
Нуммулитовый известняк, из которого пост: The nummulitic limestone from which the pyramids of Giza were built consists of foraminifera shells
Одноклеточные водоросли в стеклянных шка: Single-celled algae in glass boxes: they produce up to a fifth of the Earth’s oxygen.
Диатомеи строят панцири из кремнезёма —: Diatoms build shells of silica, essentially glass, with patterns of astonishing symmetry. They account for about 20% of the planet’s photosynthesis, roughly as much as all the tropical rainforests.\n\nDust from the Sahara, rich in the skeletons of ancient diatoms, is carried by the wind across the Atlantic and fertilizes the forests of the Amazon.
Диатомеи дают ≈ 20% первичной продукции: Diatoms account for ≈20% of the Earth’s primary production
Пыль впадины Боделе в Сахаре удобряет Ам: Dust from the Bodélé Depression in the Sahara fertilizes the Amazon with phosphorus (NASA, 2015)
Ветвь, получившая хлоропласт напрямую от: The branch that received its chloroplast directly from a cyanobacterium: red and green algae and land plants.
Архепластиды — потомки эукариота, которы: The Archaeplastida descend from a eukaryote that once swallowed a cyanobacterium and turned it into a chloroplast. This is primary endosymbiosis, an event that apparently happened only once in the whole history of life.\n\nAll other “green” organisms with chloroplasts got them secondarily, by swallowing a ready-made alga.
Первичный захват цианобактерии произошёл: The primary capture of a cyanobacterium happened in the ancestor of the Archaeplastida; in other algae the chloroplasts are secondary
Красные водоросли — одни из древнейших м: Red algae: among the oldest multicellular organisms; agar and nori are made from them.
Красные водоросли живут глубже других: и: Red algae live deeper than the others: their pigments catch blue light, which penetrates water the farthest. Bangiomorpha, about a billion years old, is one of the first multicellular organisms with sexual reproduction.\n\nRed algae give us agar, the base of culture media in microbiology, and the nori sheets used for sushi.
Зелёные водоросли — от одноклеточной хла: Green algae: from single-celled Chlamydomonas to the ancestors of all land plants.
Зелёные водоросли используют те же пигме: Green algae use the same pigments as plants: chlorophylls a and b. One of their branches, the charophytes of fresh waters, gave rise to land plants.\n\nVolvox, a ball of thousands of cells, shows how single-celled organisms became multicellular step by step.
Наземные растения происходят от харофито: Land plants descend from charophyte green algae
Джайнизм различает существ по числу чувс: Jainism classifies beings by the number of senses: plants are “one-sensed” (touch only), but they too are souls (jiva) that must not be harmed
Вернадский — «живое вещество» как геолог: Vernadsky — “living matter” as a geological force that transformed the planet
Прогулка среди деревьев 20 минут без тел: A 20-minute walk among trees without your phone: notice that the forest is a shared organism of roots, mycelium and crowns.
Растения выходят на сушу — с союзниками-: Plants come onto land, with their fungal allies, and begin to create soil.
Выйти из воды — значит не высохнуть, уде: Leaving the water means not drying out, holding up your weight and getting water. The first land plants were low and had no roots. Fungi came with them: the alliance of roots and mycelium, mycorrhiza, still feeds most plants.\n\nPlants changed the whole planet: soil appeared, the water cycle through leaves, and later forests and coal seams.
Мхи и печёночники — самые простые наземн: Mosses and liverworts: the simplest land plants, without vessels.
У мхов нет настоящих корней и сосудов: в: Mosses have no true roots or vessels: water passes through their whole surface. So they are short and love moisture. Yet peat moss, sphagnum, stores about a third of the planet’s soil carbon in bogs.\n\nMany mosses survive drying out completely and revive after rain, even years later.
Торфяники занимают ≈ 3% суши, но хранят: Peatlands cover ≈3% of the land but store ≈30% of soil carbon
Растения с сосудами — внутренней «водопр: Plants with vessels, an internal “plumbing” system: now they can grow tall.
Сосуды из клеток, укреплённых лигнином,: Vessels made of cells reinforced with lignin carry water from the roots to the leaves and bear the plant’s weight. This let plants rise tens of meters high.\n\nLignin proved so tough that for a long time fungi could not break it down; this may be why huge coal seams accumulated in the Carboniferous.
Связь накопления угля с поздним появлени: The link between coal accumulation and the late appearance of lignin-decomposing fungi is a hypothesis (Floudas et al., 2012), and it is disputed
Плауны — сегодня скромные травки, а в ка: Clubmosses: modest little plants today, but in the Carboniferous trees up to 40 meters tall.
Лепидодендроны и сигиллярии — древовидны: Lepidodendron and Sigillaria, tree-like clubmosses, made up the swamp forests of the Carboniferous. Their bark with its diamond pattern is easy to recognize in coal seams.\n\nModern clubmosses are small evergreen plants; their spores were once used as flash powder by photographers.
Древовидные плауны — основа каменноуголь: Tree clubmosses were the basis of the coal forests, 359–299 million years ago
Папоротники и хвощи — растения со спорам: Ferns and horsetails: spore-bearing plants that outlived the dinosaurs.
Папоротники размножаются спорами — на ни: Ferns reproduce by spores: brown dots of sori can be seen on the underside of the leaf. After the asteroid fell 66 million years ago, a “fern spike” appears in rock layers around the world: ferns were the first to resettle the scorched land.\n\nHorsetails are living fossils, almost unchanged for hundreds of millions of years.
«Папоротниковый всплеск» на границе мела: The “fern spike” at the Cretaceous–Paleogene boundary is recorded in pollen spectra
Семя — растение в упаковке: зародыш, зап: The seed: a plant in a package, with an embryo, a food supply and a coat.
Семя позволило растениям размножаться бе: The seed allowed plants to reproduce without water: the embryo is protected and supplied with food. Seeds can wait for years until the right conditions come.\n\nThe record: a date palm grown from a seed about 2,000 years old found at the fortress of Masada; it was named Methuselah.
Финик «Мафусаил» вырос из семени возраст: The date palm “Methuselah” grew from a seed ≈2,000 years old (Sallon et al., Science, 2008)
Голосеменные: сосны, ели, гинкго, саговн: Gymnosperms: pines, spruces, ginkgo, cycads, with “naked” seeds on the scales of cones.
Gymnosperms ruled in the age of the dinosaurs. Among them are the tallest trees (redwoods up to 115 meters), the oldest (the bristlecone pine, about 4,800 years) and the most ancient by origin.\n\nGinkgo is a “living fossil”: several ginkgo trees survived the atomic bombing of Hiroshima and are still growing.
Секвойя «Гиперион» — около 116 м; остист: The redwood “Hyperion” is about 116 m tall; the bristlecone pine “Methuselah” is about 4,800 years old
Цветковые растения: цветок — союз с живо: Flowering plants: the flower is an alliance with animals, the fruit a way to travel.
Цветковые появились поздно — около 140–1: Flowering plants appeared late, about 140–130 million years ago, but quickly became the dominant plants of the planet: today there are about 300,000 species. The flower attracts pollinators with nectar and color, and the fruit invites animals to spread the seeds.\n\nDarwin called their rapid spread an “abominable mystery”. The evolution of flowers and insects went hand in hand.
Цветковых около 300 тыс. видов — примерн: There are about 300,000 species of flowering plants, roughly 90% of land plants
Молекулярные часы относят их происхожден: Molecular clocks place their origin earlier than the fossils do; the question is open
Однодольные: злаки, пальмы, орхидеи, лил: Monocots: grasses, palms, orchids, lilies, bananas.
У однодольных одна семядоля, параллельны: Monocots have one seed leaf, parallel leaf veins and flowers with parts in multiples of three. They include the orchids, one of the largest plant families (about 28,000 species), whose flowers sometimes mimic female insects.
Орхидных ≈ 28 тыс. видов — одно из двух: Orchids number ≈28,000 species, one of the two largest families of flowering plants
Злаки кормят человечество: пшеница, рис: Grasses feed humanity: wheat, rice and maize provide about half of people’s calories.
Злаки распространились в кайнозое и созд: Grasses spread in the Cenozoic and created steppes and savannas: pastures for hoofed animals and the setting in which our ancestors took shape. Their leaves grow from the base, so grasses withstand grazing and mowing.\n\nHumans domesticated wheat, barley, rice, maize and millet, and all of civilization grew up on grain.
Рис, пшеница и кукуруза дают ≈ 50% калор: Rice, wheat and maize provide ≈50% of the calories people consume
Двудольные: розы, бобы, дубы, подсолнухи: Dicots: roses, beans, oaks, sunflowers, coffee — most flowering plants.
Двудольные — около трёх четвертей цветко: Dicots make up about three quarters of flowering plants. Legumes, in alliance with root-nodule bacteria, take nitrogen from the air and fertilize the soil. The largest flower, Rafflesia (up to a meter across), belongs to the flowering plants, and so do the largest trees by mass among them: eucalyptus and oak.
Бобовые с клубеньковыми бактериями фикси: Legumes with root-nodule bacteria fix atmospheric nitrogen
Общие предки грибов и животных: клетки с: The common ancestors of fungi and animals: cells with a single flagellum at the back, like a sperm cell.
Название значит «задний жгутик». Спермат: The name means “rear flagellum”. Animal sperm and the spores of chytrid fungi swim in the same way, pushing themselves with a tail from behind. This kinship is confirmed by genetics too.\n\nSo fungi are closer to us than to plants, which is one reason fungal infections are hard to treat: drugs that kill a fungus easily harm human cells as well.
Грибы и животные — сестринские группы вн: Fungi and animals are sister groups within the opisthokonts
Во многих культурах грибы — посредники м: In many cultures fungi are mediators between worlds; modern science speaks cautiously about the “wood wide web” of mycelium: there are data, but the scale is disputed
Грибы — не растения: они не фотосинтезир: Fungi are not plants: they do not photosynthesize but dissolve and absorb their food.
Главная часть гриба — не шляпка, а грибн: The main part of a fungus is not the cap but the mycelium, a network of fine threads in the soil. The largest known organism on Earth is a honey fungus in Oregon: its mycelium covers about 10 km² and is thousands of years old.\n\nFungi decompose the dead, feed plants through mycorrhiza, and give us bread, wine, cheese and penicillin. Their cell walls are made of chitin, the same substance as insect shells.
Грибница опёнка Armillaria в Орегоне — о: The mycelium of the honey fungus Armillaria in Oregon covers about 9–10 km²
Описано ≈ 150 тыс. видов грибов; всего,: ≈150,000 species of fungi have been described; the total is estimated at 2–4 million
Хитридиевые — водные грибы с плавающими: Chytrids: aquatic fungi with swimming spores; one of them is killing frogs all over the world.
Хитридиевые — самые «древние» по устройс: Chytrids are the most “ancient” fungi in structure: their spores swim with a flagellum. The chytrid fungus Batrachochytrium has caused the decline of hundreds of amphibian species since the 1980s, one of the most destructive diseases of wild animals.
Хитридиомикоз связан с сокращением ≈ 500: Chytridiomycosis is linked to the decline of ≈500 amphibian species (Scheele et al., Science, 2019)
Гломеромицеты — грибы микоризы: вместе с: Glomeromycetes, the fungi of mycorrhiza: they came onto land together with the first plants.
Нити гломеромицетов проникают внутрь кор: Glomeromycete threads penetrate roots and trade water and minerals for the plant’s sugars. Fossil remains of such mycorrhiza have been found in plants about 400 million years old: the alliance is almost as old as the land itself.
Арбускулярная микориза обнаружена у иско: Arbuscular mycorrhiza has been found in fossil plants from the Rhynie chert (≈407 million years)
Аскомицеты: дрожжи, плесени, трюфели, см: Ascomycetes: yeasts, molds, truffles, morels and Penicillium.
Пекарские дрожжи — одноклеточный аскомиц: Baker’s yeast is a single-celled ascomycete: it makes bread rise and gives wine its alcohol. Penicillium gave us the first antibiotic. Many lichens are an alliance of an ascomycete with an alga or a cyanobacterium.\n\nYeast is a model organism of genetics: about a third of its genes have counterparts in humans.
Дрожжи Saccharomyces cerevisiae — первый: The yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae was the first eukaryote to have its genome fully read (1996)
Подберёзовик, мухомор, вешенка — всё это: Birch boletes, fly agarics, oyster mushrooms: all of these are basidiomycetes. Bracket fungi learned to break down lignin, the toughest substance in wood; without them the forest would choke on dead trunks.\n\nThe spores of a mushroom are shot off by a droplet of water with an acceleration of tens of thousands of g.
Баллистоспоры базидиомицетов отстреливаю: The ballistospores of basidiomycetes are launched with an acceleration of ≈10,000 g or more
Хоанофлагелляты — одноклеточные, ближайш: Choanoflagellates: single-celled organisms, the closest living relatives of animals.
Клетка хоанофлагелляты — жгутик в «ворот: A choanoflagellate cell, a flagellum in a “collar” of microvilli, is almost indistinguishable from the cells of sponges. Some species form colonies, and substances from bacteria “switch on” this behavior.\n\nIn choanoflagellates, proteins have been found that animals need to join cells and pass signals: many “tools of multicellularity” appeared before animals themselves.
Хоанофлагелляты — сестринская группа жив: Choanoflagellates are the sister group of animals
Аристотель, «История животных» — лестниц: Aristotle, “History of Animals” — the ladder of beings (scala naturae): from stones through plants and animals to humans; later the Neoplatonists extended it to the One
Буддизм — шесть миров перерождения, сред: Buddhism — the six realms of rebirth, among them the animal realm: all living things are linked by a chain of births
Лестница существ — образ иерархии, а не: The ladder of beings is an image of hierarchy, not of evolution: for Aristotle species are unchanging. The tree of kinship is branching, and in it there are no “higher” and “lower”
Животные — многоклеточные, которые питаю: Animals are multicellular organisms that feed on others and move; most have nerves and muscles.
Первые животные появились, вероятно, 800: The first animals probably appeared 800–650 million years ago, but reliable fossils date only from about 575–558 million years ago (the Ediacaran biota). Animal cells are bound by the protein collagen, the most abundant protein in our bodies.\n\nAnimals invented nerve cells, muscles, the gut and, in the end, the brain. About 1.5 million species have been described, and most of them are insects.
Время появления животных по молекулярным: Molecular clocks date the appearance of animals to 800–650 million years ago; the fossils date it later
Холестерин в окаменелостях дикинсонии (5: Cholesterol in Dickinsonia fossils (558 million years) confirmed its animal nature
Коллаген, клетки, связанные в ткани, нер: Collagen, cells bound into tissues, nerve cells and muscles, an early plan of embryonic development.
Губки — самые простые животные: без нерв: Sponges: the simplest animals, with no nerves, muscles or organs.
Губка — фильтр: её клетки гонят воду чер: A sponge is a filter: its cells drive water through pores and catch food particles. If a sponge is pushed through a sieve, its cells will gather back together on their own.\n\nSome glass sponges live more than 10,000 years, among the longest-lived creatures. Which split off first, sponges or comb jellies, is one of the great debates of zoology.
Какая ветвь — губки или гребневики — отд: Which branch, sponges or comb jellies, split off from the other animals first is debated; 2023 data lean toward comb jellies
Гребневики — прозрачные хищники с перели: Comb jellies: transparent predators with comb plates that shimmer like a rainbow.
Гребневики плавают рядами ресничек, кото: Comb jellies swim with rows of cilia that refract light and create running rainbow stripes. Their nervous system is built so unusually that some scientists think nerves may have arisen twice in animals.\n\nThe comb jelly Mnemiopsis, accidentally brought into the Black Sea, wrecked the fisheries there in the 1980s.
Независимое возникновение нервной систем: The independent origin of the nervous system in comb jellies is a hypothesis (a syncytial nerve net, Science, 2023)
Эдиакарская биота — первые крупные сущес: The Ediacaran biota: the first large creatures, disks, “fronds” and “mattresses” on the seafloor.
Около 575 млн лет назад на дне морей поя: About 575 million years ago soft creatures up to a meter long appeared on the seafloor, without mouths, eyes or legs. Dickinsonia may have fed by absorbing food through its whole body from a bacterial mat.\n\nMost Ediacaran forms left no descendants. They disappeared about 539 million years ago, before the Cambrian explosion.
Дикинсония — достоверное животное (холес: Dickinsonia is a confirmed animal (cholesterol, 558 million years)
Родство большинства эдиакарских форм с с: The relationship of most Ediacaran forms to modern groups is unclear
Стрекающие: медузы, кораллы, актинии, ги: Cnidarians: jellyfish, corals, sea anemones, hydras, with stinging harpoon cells.
Стрекательная клетка выстреливает нить б: A stinging cell fires a thread faster than a bullet, one of the fastest movements in living nature. Corals in alliance with algae build reefs that can be seen from space.\n\nThe jellyfish Turritopsis can return to the juvenile polyp stage; it is called “immortal”. And the hydra hardly ages at all.
Выстрел стрекательной капсулы — одно из: The discharge of a stinging capsule is one of the fastest movements in biology (≈1/700,000 s)
Turritopsis dohrnii способна обращать ра: Turritopsis dohrnii can reverse its development
Почти во всех мифах творения мир устроен: In almost every creation myth the world is arranged symmetrically, right and left, above and below; in animals this symmetry arose about 600 million years ago
Двусторонне-симметричные: у тела появляю: Bilaterians: the body gains a front and a back, a top and a bottom, a head and a through-gut.
Почти все животные, кроме губок, гребнев: Almost all animals except sponges, comb jellies and cnidarians are bilaterians: their left and right halves mirror each other. Moving forward required a head, a place where sense organs and nerve cells gather.\n\nSo began cephalization, the road to the brain. The Hox genes, which lay out the body plan “from head to tail”, are strikingly similar in a fly and a human.
Гены Hox управляют планом тела у всех би: Hox genes control the body plan in all bilaterians, from flies to humans
Правая и левая стороны, голова с органам: Right and left sides, a head with sense organs, a gut with a mouth and an anus, Hox genes.
Первичноротые: черви, моллюски, членисто: Protostomes: worms, mollusks, arthropods; in the embryo the first opening becomes the mouth.
У зародыша животного сначала образуется: In an animal embryo an infolding forms first: the primary mouth. In protostomes it becomes the mouth, while in deuterostomes (which include us) it becomes the anus, and the mouth breaks through anew.\n\nProtostomes are the overwhelming majority of animal species.
Деление на первичноротых и вторичноротых: The division into protostomes and deuterostomes is confirmed by molecular phylogeny (with refinements)
Линяющие: все, кто растёт, сбрасывая ста: Molting animals: all those that grow by shedding their old cuticle, from nematode worms to insects.
Твёрдый наружный покров не растягивается: A hard outer covering does not stretch, so such animals have to molt. Grouping nematodes with arthropods on the basis of molting seemed strange at first, but genes confirmed it (1997).
Клада линяющих (Ecdysozoa) выделена по м: The molting clade (Ecdysozoa) was defined from molecular data in 1997 (Aguinaldo et al.)
Нематоды — круглые черви; их больше всег: Nematodes: roundworms, the most numerous animals by number of individuals.
В почве на квадратный метр приходятся ми: A square meter of soil holds millions of nematodes. The 1-mm worm C. elegans is a star of biology: the fate of each of its 959 cells and all 302 of its neurons is known. Studies of it revealed apoptosis and RNA interference (Nobel Prizes of 2002 and 2006).
У C. elegans 302 нейрона; его «коннектом: C. elegans has 302 neurons; its “connectome” was the first complete map of a nervous system (1986)
Членистоногие — самый успешный тип живот: Arthropods, the most successful animal phylum: insects, spiders, crustaceans, millipedes.
Наружный скелет из хитина и суставчатые: An outer skeleton of chitin and jointed legs gave arthropods a universal “construction kit”. They were the first animals to come onto land and the first to fly.\n\nArthropods make up more than 80% of described animal species.
Членистоногие — более 80% описанных видо: Arthropods: more than 80% of described animal species
Трилобиты — «жуки» древних морей; жили п: Trilobites, the “beetles” of ancient seas: they lived for almost 300 million years and vanished in the Permian catastrophe.
Трилобиты одними из первых обрели настоя: Trilobites were among the first to acquire true eyes, made of crystals of calcite, a transparent mineral. More than 20,000 species are known, from a millimeter to 70 centimeters long.\n\nThey survived several mass extinctions, but the last one, the Permian, 252 million years ago, was their end.
Глаза трилобитов — линзы из кальцита; из: Trilobite eyes had lenses of calcite; more than 20,000 species are known
Хелицеровые: пауки, скорпионы, клещи и м: Chelicerates: spiders, scorpions, mites and horseshoe crabs.
Мечехвосты — живые ископаемые, почти не: Horseshoe crabs are living fossils, almost unchanged for 450 million years. Their blue blood (with copper instead of iron) is used to test the sterility of medicines and vaccines.\n\nThe silk of some spiders is stronger than steel of the same thickness. Spiders are among the main predators on land: they eat hundreds of millions of tons of insects a year.
Пауки съедают по оценке 400–800 млн т до: Spiders eat an estimated 400–800 million tons of prey a year (Nyffeler and Birkhofer, 2017)
Лизат крови мечехвоста (LAL-тест) — стан: Horseshoe crab blood lysate (the LAL test) is the standard test for bacterial toxins
Ракообразные: крабы, креветки, раки, кри: Crustaceans: crabs, shrimp, crayfish, krill, and, as it turned out, the ancestors of insects.
Ракообразные — главная часть морского пл: Crustaceans are the main part of marine plankton: Antarctic krill is one of the most abundant animal species by mass. Genetics showed that insects grew out of the crustaceans: an insect is a “crustacean” that came onto land.
Насекомые — ветвь внутри ракообразных (к: Insects are a branch within the crustaceans (the clade Pancrustacea)
Насекомые — больше половины всех описанн: Insects: more than half of all described living species; the first animals to fly.
Шесть ног, три отдела тела, часто крылья: Six legs, three body sections, often wings. Insects took to the air about 325 million years ago, 100 million years before the pterosaurs. More than a million species have been described, and there may be 5.5 million in all.\n\nMetamorphosis, the transformation of a larva into an adult, allowed young and adults to live different lives and not compete.
Описано > 1 млн видов насекомых; оценка: More than 1 million insect species have been described; the total is estimated at ≈5.5 million (Stork, 2018)
Время появления насекомых по молекулярны: Molecular clocks date the appearance of insects to ≈480 million years ago, fossils to ≈400
Жуки — самый богатый видами отряд живых: Beetles: the most species-rich order of living things.
Жуков описано около 400 тысяч видов — ка: About 400,000 species of beetles have been described, one in five animal species. When the biologist Haldane was asked what one could learn about the Creator by studying nature, he is said to have replied: “An inordinate fondness for beetles.”\n\nTough wing cases protect beetles and have let them conquer almost every environment.
Жесткокрылых описано ≈ 400 тыс. видов: ≈400,000 species of beetles have been described
Пчёлы, осы и муравьи — изобретатели слож: Bees, wasps and ants: the inventors of complex societies.
Муравьи и пчёлы создали «суперорганизмы»: Ants and bees created “superorganisms”: colonies in which thousands of individuals act as one. A bee tells its sisters the direction and distance to flowers with a dance; Karl von Frisch received the Nobel Prize in 1973 for decoding it.\n\nAccording to a 2022 estimate, there are about 20 quadrillion ants on Earth, 2.5 million for every person.
Танец пчёл расшифрован Карлом фон Фришем: The bee dance was decoded by Karl von Frisch (Nobel Prize 1973)
Бабочки и моли — от гусеницы к крылатому: Butterflies and moths: from caterpillar to winged creature by way of the pupa.
В куколке тело гусеницы почти полностью: Inside the pupa the caterpillar’s body almost completely dissolves, and the butterfly is assembled from groups of “sleeping” cells. Experiments have shown that a butterfly can remember what the caterpillar learned.\n\nThe monarch butterfly migrates 4,000 km from Canada to Mexico, and the full annual cycle of migration takes several generations.
Память о выученной реакции может сохраня: A learned response can be remembered through metamorphosis (Blackiston et al., 2008)
Спиральные: моллюски, кольчатые черви, п: Spiralians: mollusks, segmented worms, flatworms, bryozoans.
Название — от спирального деления клеток: The name comes from the spiral division of embryonic cells in many of its members. This branch includes earthworms, snails and octopuses, the most intelligent invertebrates.
Клада Lophotrochozoa выделена по молекул: The clade Lophotrochozoa was defined from molecular data
Кольчатые черви — дождевые черви, пиявки: Segmented worms: earthworms, leeches, marine polychaetes.
Дарвин посвятил дождевым червям последню: Darwin devoted his last book to earthworms (1881): he calculated that over the years worms pass the whole topsoil through their bodies and gradually bury ancient stones. Leeches are still used in medicine to restore blood flow after surgery.
Медицинские пиявки одобрены FDA как меди: Medicinal leeches were approved by the FDA as a medical device (2004)
Моллюски: улитки, двустворки, осьминоги: Mollusks: snails, bivalves, octopuses, from scallops with a hundred eyes to giant squid.
Моллюсков около 85 тысяч видов. У гребеш: There are about 85,000 species of mollusks. A scallop has up to 200 eyes with mirrors, and the giant squid has the largest eyes in the animal kingdom, up to 27 cm across.\n\nShells of mother-of-pearl are an example of biological engineering stronger than ceramics.
Глаза гигантского и колоссального кальма: The eyes of the giant and colossal squid are the largest in the animal kingdom (≈27 cm)
Головоногие: осьминоги, кальмары, карака: Cephalopods: octopuses, squid, cuttlefish, the most intelligent invertebrates.
У осьминога около 500 млн нейронов — две: An octopus has about 500 million neurons, two thirds of them in its arms, which partly “think” for themselves. Octopuses open jars, escape from aquariums and recognize people. Cuttlefish change the color of their skin in a fraction of a second, although they themselves apparently cannot see color.\n\nTheir eye resembles ours but is built more “correctly”: it has no blind spot. The similarity arose independently, an example of convergence.
Глаза головоногих и позвоночных — класси: The eyes of cephalopods and vertebrates are a classic example of convergent evolution
Аммониты — моллюски в спиральных раковин: Ammonites: mollusks in spiral shells; they vanished together with the dinosaurs.
Аммониты жили около 340 млн лет и были т: Ammonites lived for about 340 million years and were so numerous and changed so quickly that geologists use them to date rock layers. Their shells coil in a spiral close to a logarithmic one.\n\nThe last ammonites died in the Cretaceous–Paleogene catastrophe 66 million years ago, while their distant relatives, the nautiluses, are still alive.
Аммониты — руководящие окаменелости для: Ammonites are index fossils for dating Mesozoic layers
Вторичноротые: иглокожие и хордовые — у: Deuterostomes: echinoderms and chordates; in the embryo the first opening becomes the anus.
Звучит странно, но по развитию зародыша: It sounds strange, but by embryonic development a starfish is closer to us than an octopus or a fly. We and the echinoderms are deuterostomes: our mouth breaks through second.
Иглокожие: морские звёзды, ежи, голотури: Echinoderms: starfish, sea urchins, sea cucumbers, with five-rayed symmetry and water “hydraulics”.
Взрослые иглокожие пятилучевые, но их ли: Adult echinoderms are five-rayed, but their larvae are bilaterally symmetrical, a memory of their bilaterian ancestors. A starfish can regrow a lost arm, and sometimes a whole starfish grows from a single arm. It digests its prey by turning its stomach inside out.
Иглокожие способны к значительной регене: Echinoderms are capable of extensive regeneration
Хордовые: у всех на каком-то этапе есть: Chordates: all of them have a notochord at some stage, a flexible rod along the back.
У зародыша человека тоже есть хорда, жаб: A human embryo also has a notochord, gill slits and a tail; later they turn into the spine, parts of the ear and throat, and the tailbone. The notochord is the support and axis of the body, along which lies the neural tube.\n\nThe Cambrian Pikaia from the Burgess Shale is one of the early chordates.
Хорда, нервная трубка на спине и жаберны: A notochord, a dorsal neural tube and gill slits are the shared features of chordates
Хорда (у нас — межпозвоночные диски), не: The notochord (in us, the intervertebral discs), the neural tube along the back, the gill arches from which the jaws and ear bones grew.
Ланцетники — живая модель ранних хордовы: Lancelets, a living model of early chordates: a notochord for life, no skull or backbone.
Ланцетник длиной несколько сантиметров з: A lancelet a few centimeters long burrows into the sand and filters water. It has no real brain or eyes, but its body plan is the same as that of vertebrates. It is used to study how our own body plan came about.
Ланцетники (бесчерепные) сохраняют хорду: Lancelets (cephalochordates) keep their notochord all their lives
Оболочники: асцидии — ближайшие живые ро: Tunicates: sea squirts, the closest living relatives of vertebrates, though they look like little sacs.
Личинка асцидии похожа на головастика: у: A sea squirt larva looks like a tadpole: it has a notochord, a neural tube and a tail. As an adult it attaches to a rock and… absorbs its own “brain”, which it no longer needs for moving.\n\nMolecular data showed that tunicates are closer to vertebrates than lancelets are.
Оболочники — сестринская группа позвоноч: Tunicates are the sister group of vertebrates (Delsuc et al., 2006)
Позвоночные: череп, позвоночник и мозг в: Vertebrates: a skull, a backbone and a brain in a protective case.
Позвоночные появились в кембрии — около: Vertebrates appeared in the Cambrian, about 520 million years ago. Inventions helped them: the neural crest (special embryonic cells that build the skull, the face and skin pigment), camera eyes and paired sense organs.\n\nOf the 70,000 species of vertebrates, half are fish.
Нервный гребень — особенность позвоночны: The neural crest is unique to vertebrates; the bones of the face and much else are built from it
Череп и позвоночник, глаза-камеры с хрус: A skull and a backbone, camera eyes with a lens, and the neural crest that built our face.
Миноги и миксины — бесчелюстные позвоноч: Lampreys and hagfish: jawless vertebrates, living witnesses of the age before jaws.
У миноги рот — присоска с роговыми зубам: A lamprey’s mouth is a sucker with horny teeth. Hagfish release a bucket of slime in seconds, which chokes attacking predators. These ancient lineages show how vertebrates lived before jaws were invented.
Миноги и миксины — единственные живые бе: Lampreys and hagfish are the only living jawless vertebrates
Челюстноротые: из жаберных дуг вырастают: Gnathostomes: jaws grow from the gill arches, a new way of eating.
Челюсти позволили хватать крупную добычу: Jaws made it possible to seize large prey and become predators. The oldest undoubted jawed vertebrate is Fanjingshania from China, about 439 million years old. Together with jaws came paired fins, the future limbs.
Панцирные рыбы — первые владыки морей; и: Placoderms, the armored fish: the first lords of the seas; they vanished at the end of the Devonian.
Дунклеостей длиной до 6–8 метров вместо: Dunkleosteus, up to 6–8 meters long, had bony shearing plates instead of teeth and bit with enormous force. Finds show that internal fertilization and live birth first appeared in placoderms: the fossil female “Mother Fish” with an embryo (2008).
Materpiscis — древнейшее известное живор: Materpiscis is the oldest known live birth in vertebrates (≈380 million years, Nature, 2008)
Хрящевые рыбы: акулы, скаты, химеры — ск: Cartilaginous fish: sharks, rays, chimaeras, with a skeleton of cartilage, not bone.
Акулы старше деревьев: они появились бол: Sharks are older than trees: they appeared more than 400 million years ago. The Greenland shark lives about 270–500 years, the longest-lived vertebrate. Sharks sense the electric fields of prey with special organs, the ampullae of Lorenzini.
Возраст гренландской акулы по радиоуглер: The age of the Greenland shark from radiocarbon in the eye lens: 272–512 years (Science, 2016)
Костные рыбы — скелет из кости и плавате: Bony fish: a skeleton of bone and a swim bladder, from which the lungs later grew.
Костные рыбы делятся на лучепёрых (почти: Bony fish are divided into ray-finned fish (almost all modern fish) and lobe-finned fish (our branch). Early bony fish had both gills and lungs; in ray-finned fish the lungs turned into a swim bladder.
Плавательный пузырь и лёгкие — гомологич: The swim bladder and the lungs are homologous organs
Лучепёрые рыбы — больше половины всех ви: Ray-finned fish: more than half of all vertebrate species.
Около 30 тысяч видов: от рыбки длиной 8: About 30,000 species, from a fish 8 mm long to the ocean sunfish weighing more than two tons. They have conquered every body of water on the planet, from mountain streams to a depth of 8 km (the record is a snailfish at 8,336 m, 2022).
Самая глубоководная снятая рыба — 8336 м: The deepest fish ever filmed: 8,336 m (Izu–Ogasawara Trench, 2022)
Лопастепёрые: рыбы с мясистыми плавникам: Lobe-finned fish: fish with fleshy fins on bones, our ancestors.
В плавнике лопастепёрой рыбы уже есть сх: The fin of a lobe-finned fish already contains the plan of our arm: one bone, then two, then many small ones. Tetrapods came from this branch. Today only coelacanths and lungfish are still alive.
Схема «одна кость — две кости — много ко: The plan of “one bone, two bones, many little bones” can be traced from lobe-finned fish to humans
Кости плеча, предплечья и кисти — переде: The bones of the upper arm, forearm and hand are a remodeled fin of a lobe-finned fish.
Целакант — «живое ископаемое», найденное: The coelacanth: a “living fossil” found alive in 1938.
Целакантов считали вымершими вместе с ди: Coelacanths were thought to have died out together with the dinosaurs, until in 1938 a museum curator in South Africa, Marjorie Courtenay-Latimer, saw a strange blue fish in a catch. Later a second species was found in Indonesia. Coelacanths live up to 100 years.
Латимерия открыта в 1938 году; продолжит: Latimeria was discovered in 1938; its lifespan is about 100 years (2021)
Двоякодышащие рыбы — ближайшие живые род: Lungfish: the closest living relatives of tetrapods.
Двоякодышащие дышат и жабрами, и лёгкими: Lungfish breathe with both gills and lungs, and in a drought they burrow into the mud and sleep in a cocoon for up to four years. The genome of the Australian lungfish is one of the largest among animals, 14 times larger than ours.
Геном австралийского рогозуба ≈ 43 млрд: The genome of the Australian lungfish is ≈43 billion base pairs (Nature, 2021)
Четвероногие: плавники становятся ногами: Tetrapods: fins become legs, and vertebrates come onto land.
Тиктаалик (375 млн лет) — рыба с шеей и: Tiktaalik (375 million years) is a fish with a neck and a “wrist”. The first tetrapods, Ichthyostega and Acanthostega, still lived in water and had 6–8 digits on each limb. The five-fingered hand became fixed later.\n\nOn land everything had to be solved anew: how to breathe air, hold up your weight, not dry out and hear in air.
Тиктаалик — 375 млн лет; следы четвероно: Tiktaalik: 375 million years; tetrapod tracks from Poland: about 395 million years
Четыре конечности с пальцами, лёгкие для: Four limbs with digits, lungs for breathing air, a neck.
Земноводные: лягушки, тритоны, червяги —: Amphibians: frogs, newts, caecilians, life between water and land.
Большинство амфибий откладывают икру в в: Most amphibians lay their eggs in water, and tadpoles breathe with gills. The axolotl can regrow limbs and parts of its heart and brain. Today amphibians are the most threatened group of vertebrates: about 41% of species are at risk.
Амниоты: яйцо с оболочками — свой «пруд»: Amniotes: an egg with membranes, a “pond” of its own inside, frees them from water.
Амниоты изобрели яйцо с зародышевыми обо: Amniotes invented an egg with embryonic membranes and a supply of water: now it was possible to breed far from water. We have an amnion too: it is the amniotic sac in which a baby grows.\n\nSoon after they appeared, the amniotes split into two branches: the sauropsids (reptiles and birds) and the synapsids (our line).
Гилономус — один из древнейших амниот, ≈: Hylonomus, one of the oldest amniotes, ≈312 million years
Амнион — околоплодный пузырь, плотная ко: The amnion, the amniotic sac; a dense skin that prevents drying out.
Завропсиды: черепахи, ящерицы, змеи, кро: Sauropsids: turtles, lizards, snakes, crocodiles, dinosaurs and birds.
Это сестринская к нам ветвь амниот. Она: This is the amniote branch that is our sister. It produced the largest land animals, the sauropods, and the most diverse group of land vertebrates, the birds, with about 11,000 species.
Птиц ≈ 11 тыс. видов — больше, чем млеко: There are ≈11,000 species of birds, more than mammals
Черепахи — панцирь из рёбер и позвонков;: Turtles: a shell of ribs and vertebrae; they live up to 190 years.
Панцирь черепахи — не «домик», а сросшие: A turtle’s shell is not a “little house” but fused ribs and vertebrae. The early turtle Odontochelys (220 million years) had a shell only underneath. Jonathan, a Seychelles giant tortoise hatched around 1832, is the oldest known land animal.
Ящерицы и змеи — более 11 тысяч видов че: Lizards and snakes: more than 11,000 species of squamates.
Чешуйчатые — самая большая группа рептил: Squamates are the largest group of reptiles. Geckos run up glass thanks to billions of tiny hairs on their toes; chameleons change color by rearranging crystals in their skin.
Сцепление гекконов — силы Ван-дер-Ваальс: Gecko adhesion: van der Waals forces on hair-like setae (Autumn et al., Nature, 2000)
Змеи — потерянные ноги и тепловое зрение: Snakes: lost legs and heat vision.
Змеи произошли от ящериц, утративших кон: Snakes evolved from lizards that lost their limbs. Pythons still have remnants of pelvic bones. Rattlesnakes and pythons “see” the heat of their prey with heat-sensing pits.
У питонов и удавов сохраняются рудименты: Pythons and boas keep vestiges of hind limbs
Архозавры — «правящие ящеры»: крокодилы,: Archosaurs, the “ruling reptiles”: crocodiles, pterosaurs, dinosaurs, birds.
Архозавры захватили сушу в триасе. Их об: Archosaurs took over the land in the Triassic. Their shared features are openings in the skull in front of the eyes and teeth set in sockets. Crocodiles and birds are the two living branches of archosaurs, so a crocodile is closer to a sparrow than to a lizard.
Ближайшие живые родственники птиц — крок: The closest living relatives of birds are crocodiles
Крокодилы — родственники динозавров, пер: Crocodiles: relatives of the dinosaurs that outlived them almost unchanged.
Крокодилы заботятся о потомстве и перено: Crocodiles care for their young and carry hatchlings in their mouths. They have a four-chambered heart, like birds and like us. They survived the mass extinction 66 million years ago, perhaps thanks to their slow metabolism.
Птерозавры — первые летающие позвоночные: Pterosaurs: the first flying vertebrates, with wingspans of up to 10–11 meters.
Крыло птерозавра — кожная перепонка на о: A pterosaur wing is a membrane of skin stretched on one elongated finger. Quetzalcoatlus, the size of a giraffe, took off with a leap on all four limbs. Pterosaurs are not dinosaurs but their close relatives.
Динозавры — властелины суши мезозоя, а и: Dinosaurs: the rulers of the Mesozoic land, and their descendants, the birds, are still with us.
Динозавры жили около 165 млн лет. Ноги,: Dinosaurs lived for about 165 million years. Legs set straight under the body, a fast metabolism and, in many, feathers made them successful. Paleontologists distinguish three great branches: ornithischians, sauropods and theropods.\n\nAll died out except one lineage: the birds.
Древнейшие динозавры — около 233–230 млн: The oldest dinosaurs are about 233–230 million years old
Перья были у многих групп динозавров: Many groups of dinosaurs had feathers
Птицетазовые: стегозавр, трицератопс, ан: Ornithischians: Stegosaurus, Triceratops, Ankylosaurus, the duck-billed dinosaurs, all plant-eaters.
Утконосые динозавры (гадрозавры) жили ст: Duck-billed dinosaurs (hadrosaurs) lived in herds and built nests: finds of Maiasaura, the “good mother lizard”, show that they cared for their young. Pachycephalosaurs butted their dome-shaped heads.
Гнездовья майазавры (Монтана, 1978) — св: Maiasaura nesting grounds (Montana, 1978) are evidence of parental care in dinosaurs
Завроподы — длинношеие гиганты, крупнейш: Sauropods: long-necked giants, the largest animals ever to walk on land.
Аргентинозавр весил, по оценкам, 70–90 т: Argentinosaurus weighed an estimated 70–90 tons and reached 30–35 meters. Such size was made possible by hollow bones with air sacs, as in birds, and a small head on a long neck that let it graze without moving.
Масса аргентинозавра — 65–95 т, оценки р: The mass of Argentinosaurus: 65–95 t; estimates vary
Тероподы — двуногие хищные динозавры; от: Theropods: two-legged predatory dinosaurs; birds descend from them.
Тероподы — от компактных велоцирапторов: Theropods ranged from compact velociraptors (turkey-sized and feathered) to Tyrannosaurus. They had hollow bones, a wishbone and feathers: everything birds later inherited.
Вилочка (фуркула) и полые кости — общие: The wishbone (furcula) and hollow bones are shared by theropods and birds
Тираннозавриды — от небольших оперённых: Tyrannosaurids: from small feathered hunters to Tyrannosaurus.
Ранние тираннозавроиды (юра) были мелким: Early tyrannosauroids (Jurassic) were small. Tyrannosaurus rex (68–66 million years) weighed about 8 tons and bit with a force of about 35,000 newtons, more than any other known land animal. Tyrannosaurus lived closer in time to us than to Stegosaurus.
Сила укуса тираннозавра ≈ 35–57 тыс. Н —: The bite force of Tyrannosaurus: ≈35,000–57,000 N, model estimates
Птица — образ души во многих традициях:: The bird is an image of the soul in many traditions: the Egyptian Ba, the dove of the Holy Spirit, the Simurgh of the Sufis
Птицы — живые динозавры: перья, полёт, л: Birds are living dinosaurs: feathers, flight, lungs with air sacs.
Археоптерикс (150 млн лет) — переходная: Archaeopteryx (150 million years) is a transitional form. Today there are about 11,000 species of birds. In its lifetime an Arctic tern flies the distance to the Moon and back three times. Crows and parrots solve problems at the level of small children.
Полярная крачка мигрирует ≈ 70–90 тыс. к: The Arctic tern migrates ≈70,000–90,000 km a year
Синапсиды — наша ветвь амниот; у них одн: Synapsids: our branch of amniotes, with a single temporal opening in the skull.
Синапсиды были главными наземными животн: Synapsids were the dominant land animals of the Permian, long before the dinosaurs. Dimetrodon, with a sail on its back, is not a dinosaur but a distant relative of ours. Through the therapsids (“mammal-like reptiles”), the mammals descended from them.
Диметродон — синапсида, ближе к млекопит: Dimetrodon is a synapsid, closer to mammals than to dinosaurs
Пеликозавры — ранние синапсиды, вроде ди: Pelycosaurs: early synapsids, such as Dimetrodon with a sail on its back.
Парус диметродона, вероятно, служил для: Dimetrodon’s sail probably served for display or temperature control. The pelycosaurs disappeared by the end of the Permian, giving way to the therapsids, their more “mammal-like” descendants.
Назначение паруса диметродона обсуждаетс: The purpose of Dimetrodon’s sail is debated

Сон о бабочке — одна из самых известных: The butterfly dream is one of the world’s best-known puzzles about reality and consciousness. It sits next to the “Sleep and consciousness” branch: where is the line between the dreamed and the dreamer?

Его «Сад» в Афинах принимал женщин и раб: His “Garden” in Athens admitted women and slaves, unheard of in his time. Contrary to legend, Epicureanism is not gluttony but a modest life without fear of the gods and of death.

Поэма «О природе вещей» — шесть книг лат: The poem “On the Nature of Things” is six books of Latin hexameters setting out the teaching of Epicurus: atoms, the void, the infinity of worlds, the origin of life and civilization.
Поэма почти исчезла в Средние века. В 14: The poem almost disappeared in the Middle Ages. In 1417 the humanist Poggio Bracciolini found a manuscript in a German monastery, and it became one of the sparks of the modern age: Montaigne, Gassendi and Newton read it.

Асаны в сутрах занимают всего несколько: Asanas take up only a few lines in the sutras: originally yoga is above all work with the mind. The site’s practices — breath, attention, body — continue this line.

Пустота у Нагарджуны — не ничто, а отсут: For Nagarjuna emptiness is not nothing but the absence of a separate essence: a thing is its relationships. The modern physicist Carlo Rovelli has told how this idea helped him understand quantum mechanics: one of the bridges across the river.

Плотин стал мостом между Платоном и мист: Plotinus became a bridge between Plato and the mysticism of three religions: through Augustine and Dionysius the Areopagite into Christianity, through the “Theology of Aristotle” into Islam. His ladder of emanations resembles the site’s ring of stations, running down from the Absolute.
Над дворцом Индры раскинута бесконечная: Above Indra’s palace stretches an infinite net; at every knot is a jewel, and each reflects all the others: everything is contained in everything.
Огромная сутра «Цветочной гирлянды» стал: The vast “Flower Garland” sutra became the foundation of the Chinese Huayan school. The teacher Fazang (7th–8th centuries) explained it to the empress with a statue of the Buddha among mirrors: each reflected all the reflections.

Брахман реален, мир — видимость (майя),: Brahman is real, the world is appearance (maya), and the living being is in essence no other than Brahman.
Величайший учитель недвойственной ведант: The greatest teacher of non-dual Vedanta. According to tradition, in a short life he walked across India, wrote commentaries on the Upanishads, the Bhagavad Gita and the Brahma Sutras, and founded monasteries that still exist.
Знаменитый образ: верёвку в сумерках при: A famous image: in the dusk a rope is mistaken for a snake. The fear vanishes not by fighting the snake but by light. The state of turiya, the witness of the three states, is central for Shankara.
Есть одно Бытие; все вещи — его самопроя: There is one Being; all things are its self-manifestations, mirrors in which God sees Himself.

Богослов, ставший поэтом после встречи с: A theologian who became a poet after meeting the wandering dervish Shams of Tabriz. The “Masnavi”, six books of poetic parables, has been called “the Quran in Persian”.
Его ученики основали орден мевлеви — «кр: His students founded the Mevlevi order, the “whirling dervishes”: turning as prayer and as an image of the planets moving around the Sun. Rumi remains one of the most widely read poets in the world today.
Око, которым я вижу Бога, — то же око, к: The eye through which I see God is the same eye through which God sees me; at the ground of the soul is a silence where God is born.
Доминиканский богослов и проповедник. Ег: A Dominican theologian and preacher. His sermons on the “desert of the Godhead” and on “detachment” sounded so bold that after his death some of his propositions were condemned.
Экхарт различал Бога и Божество — безымя: Eckhart distinguished God from the Godhead, the nameless ground behind all images. Through Nicholas of Cusa his thought went further, and in the 20th century he was rediscovered by Schopenhauer, Jung and scholars of Zen.
Бог — совпадение противоположностей; мир: God is the coincidence of opposites; the world is a sphere whose center is everywhere and whose circumference is nowhere; the Earth is neither the center of the universe nor motionless.
Кардинал, математик и философ. В трактат: A cardinal, mathematician and philosopher. In his treatise “On Learned Ignorance” (1440) he showed that the infinite exceeds any of our measures, and drew a cosmological conclusion from this: the universe has no privileged center.
За столетие до Коперника он писал, что З: A century before Copernicus he wrote that the Earth moves and that other heavenly bodies may be inhabited. This is philosophy, not astronomy, but it opened the door to Bruno’s infinite cosmos.
Вселенная бесконечна; звёзды — это солнц: The universe is infinite; the stars are suns, and around them are countless worlds.
Доминиканский монах, ставший странствующ: A Dominican monk who became a wandering philosopher. In his book “On the Infinite Universe and Worlds” (1584) he joined Copernicus with Nicholas of Cusa: the Sun is only one of the stars, and the worlds are countless.
Бруно сожгли в Риме в 1600 году — прежде: Bruno was burned in Rome in 1600, above all for his theological views rather than his astronomy. His intuition about many suns was confirmed; the first planets around other stars were found only in the 1990s.
Бог, или Природа: есть одна бесконечная: God, or Nature: there is one infinite substance, and thought and extension are two of its attributes.
Отлучённый от амстердамской общины, Спин: Excommunicated by the Amsterdam community, Spinoza made his living grinding lenses and wrote the “Ethics”, built like geometry, with axioms, theorems and proofs.
Свобода для него — понимание необходимос: For him freedom is the understanding of necessity, and the highest happiness is “the intellectual love of God”. His God is not a judge or a person but the order of nature. Exactly this is how Einstein would describe his own faith two hundred and fifty years later.
Природа познаётся созерцанием её живых ф: Nature is known by contemplating its living forms: all the organs of a plant are transformations of the leaf.
Поэт, считавший делом жизни свои естеств: A poet who considered his scientific work his life’s calling. In “The Metamorphosis of Plants” (1790) he saw a single plan that turns into petal, stamen and fruit. He coined the very word “morphology”.
В «Учении о цвете» Гёте спорил с Ньютоно: In his “Theory of Colours” Goethe argued with Newton. He was wrong about the physics of the spectrum, but psychologists value his descriptions of color perception. His method of attentive, loving “looking” is close to the spirit of this site.
Мир — это моё представление; за ним стои: The world is my representation; behind it stands a single blind will, and compassion is recognizing oneself in another.
В «Мире как воле и представлении» (1819): In “The World as Will and Representation” (1819) Schopenhauer was one of the first in Europe to rely seriously on the Upanishads, through the Latin translation “Oupnek’hat”. He called the Upanishads the consolation of his life.
Через Шопенгауэра индийская мысль вошла: Through Schopenhauer, Indian thought entered European culture, reaching Nietzsche, Tolstoy, Wagner and the young Schrödinger.
Мир есть всеединство: всё связано в живо: The world is all-unity: everything is bound into a living whole, and history is the path toward its union with the Divine.
Философ, поэт и мистик, отец русской рел: A philosopher, poet and mystic, the father of Russian religious philosophy. His “Lectures on Godmanhood” (1878) drew full halls; Dostoevsky and Tolstoy were among his listeners.
Центральные образы — всеединство и София: His central images are all-unity and Sophia, the Wisdom of God. Solovyov had three visions of her, in Moscow, in London and in the Egyptian desert, and described them in the poem “Three Meetings”. A line runs from him to Florensky and Berdyaev.
Общее дело человечества — победить смерт: The common task of humanity is to conquer death, bring the ancestors back to life and settle in space.
Скромный библиотекарь Румянцевского музе: A modest librarian at the Rumyantsev Museum who turned down promotions and gave away his salary. His “Philosophy of the Common Task” came out after his death, thanks to his students.
Идея «воскрешения отцов» звучит фантасти: The idea of “resurrecting the fathers” sounds fantastic, but Russian cosmism grew out of it, with its thought of humanity going beyond the Earth. In that same library the young Tsiolkovsky studied under Fyodorov’s guidance.
Каждая душа потенциально божественна; це: Each soul is potentially divine; the goal is to manifest this divinity through work, love, knowledge or control of the mind.
Ученик Рамакришны. Его речь на Всемирном: A disciple of Ramakrishna. His speech at the World’s Parliament of Religions in Chicago in 1893 introduced the West to Vedanta and yoga. His book “Raja Yoga” (1896) is a commentary on the sutras of Patanjali.
Вивекананда встречался с Уильямом Джеймс: Vivekananda met William James and spoke about the unity of religions and about spirit and science not being enemies. Almost all of “yoga in the West” descends from this journey.
Наше обычное бодрствующее сознание — лиш: Our normal waking consciousness is but one special type of consciousness, while all about it, parted from it by the filmiest of screens, there lie potential forms of consciousness entirely different.
Врач, основатель американской психологии: A physician, founder of American psychology and author of the concept of the “stream of consciousness”. In “The Varieties of Religious Experience” (1902) he was the first to study mystical experience as a psychologist, without mockery and without dogma.
Джеймс стоит на обоих берегах: философ и: James stands on both banks: a philosopher and an experimenter. His marks of mystical experience — ineffability, noetic quality, transiency, passivity — are still used by researchers.
Мир — символ: за видимым стоит невидимое: The world is a symbol: behind the visible stands the invisible, and the icon, mathematics and nature are different windows onto one reality.
Священник, математик, инженер-электротех: A priest, mathematician, electrical engineer and art scholar. “The Pillar and Ground of the Truth” (1914) is theology; “Imaginaries in Geometry” (1922) is an attempt to interpret relativity as the boundary between the visible and invisible worlds.
В советское время он работал над электро: In Soviet times he worked on electrical insulation and permafrost studies. In the Solovki prison camp he studied extracting iodine from seaweed. He was shot in 1937.
Под личным бессознательным лежит коллект: Beneath the personal unconscious lies the collective unconscious, a layer of archetypal images shared by all people, which speak to us in dreams and myths.
Ученик и оппонент Фрейда. Юнг изучал сны: Freud’s student and opponent. Jung studied dreams, mandalas, alchemy, the “Tibetan Book of the Dead” and “The Secret of the Golden Flower”, seeing in them maps of the inner path of individuation.
Вместе с физиком Вольфгангом Паули он пи: Together with the physicist Wolfgang Pauli he wrote about “synchronicity”, meaningful coincidences. This is a hypothesis, not a discovery, which is why their bridge is marked ◐.
Эволюция имеет направление — к росту соз: Evolution has a direction, toward the growth of consciousness; above the biosphere a noosphere is born, an envelope of thought striving toward the Omega Point.
Иезуит и палеонтолог, участник раскопок: A Jesuit and paleontologist who took part in the excavation of Peking Man. His book “The Phenomenon of Man” was published only after his death: the Church forbade him to publish philosophical works.
Слово «ноосфера» родилось в Париже в 192: The word “noosphere” was born in Paris in the 1920s in the circle of Teilhard, the philosopher Édouard Le Roy and Vernadsky, who was attending lectures there. Each gave it a different meaning; the bridge across the river is about this.
Спроси себя «Кто я?» и иди за этим вопро: Ask yourself “Who am I?” and follow this question to its source: there the thought “I” dissolves into pure being.
В шестнадцать лет пережил переживание см: At sixteen he went through an experience of death and awakening, left for the sacred mountain Arunachala and lived there for the rest of his life. For many years he hardly spoke: he taught by presence.
Его метод самоисследования (атма-вичара): His method of self-inquiry (atma vichara) is utterly simple and requires no faith. It is one of the purest modern forms of what the Upanishads and Shankara spoke of.
Если наука убедительно опровергнет какое: If science convincingly disproves some claim of Buddhism, Buddhism must change it.
Тэнцзин Гьяцо с юности интересуется техн: Tenzin Gyatso has been interested in technology and science since his youth. Since 1987 he has taken part in the Mind & Life dialogues with neuroscientists, physicists and psychologists.
Из этих встреч выросла целая область — и: A whole field grew out of these meetings: the study of meditation in laboratories, with monks in scanners and measurements of attention and compassion.
Плоское существо не может вообразить «вв: A flat creature cannot imagine “up”, and perhaps we are just as blind to a direction we do not see.
Директор Городской школы Лондона и богос: The headmaster of the City of London School and theologian wrote a short novella, “Flatland: A Romance of Many Dimensions”. Its hero, A Square, lives in a flat world; one day a Sphere passes through his plane, and to the Square it appears as a point, a circle that grows and shrinks.
Повесть — одновременно сатира на сословн: The story is both a satire on class-bound Victorian England and a parable of insight: the Square, having seen the third dimension, tries to tell others about it and is thrown into prison. The analogy of “flat creatures” has since been the main tool for thinking about higher dimensions.
Четвёртое измерение — не только геометри: The fourth dimension is not only geometry but a path of consciousness: we see only cross-sections of a fuller world.
Журналист и математик по образованию, Ус: A journalist and mathematician by training, Ouspensky wrote “The Fourth Dimension” (1909) and “Tertium Organum” (1912), a “third organon” of thought after Aristotle and Bacon. He drew directly on Hinton and on the analogy of flat creatures.
Позже, в «Новой модели Вселенной» (1931): Later, in “A New Model of the Universe” (1931), he proposed three-dimensional time: the fourth dimension is the time of a life, the fifth is eternity, the sixth the realization of all possibilities. This is not physics but a contemplative model, yet it resonates remarkably with how people later came to speak about time and possibilities.
систематические записи с VIII–VII вв. до: systematic records from the 8th–7th centuries BCE
Небо можно предсказывать: если веками за: The sky can be predicted: if observations are recorded for centuries, repeating cycles emerge in them.
Писцы Вавилона вели «астрономические дне: The scribes of Babylon kept “astronomical diaries” for several centuries in a row, the longest series of observations in the ancient world. They knew the eclipse cycle (the saros, ≈18 years) and calculated the motion of the Moon and planets with arithmetical schemes.
Это ещё не наука о причинах — наблюдения: This is not yet a science of causes: the observations served predictions for kings. But the very idea of precise records and checking a forecast is the first step toward measurement. Hipparchus used Babylonian data directly.
В центре — Солнце, Земля движется вокруг: The Sun is at the center, the Earth moves around it and spins on its axis; the Sun is many times larger than the Earth.
Единственный дошедший трактат Аристарха: Aristarchus’ only surviving treatise, “On the Sizes and Distances of the Sun and Moon”, estimates their sizes geometrically. The numbers are inaccurate because angles were hard to measure, but the conclusion is clear: the Sun is enormous.
О гелиоцентрической гипотезе мы знаем от: We know of the heliocentric hypothesis from Archimedes. It did not take hold for eighteen centuries. Copernicus knew of Aristarchus and mentioned him in a manuscript, then crossed the passage out.
Окружность Земли можно измерить тенью: в: The circumference of the Earth can be measured with a shadow: at noon in Syene the Sun is at the zenith, while in Alexandria it is off by 1/50 of a circle.
Хранитель Александрийской библиотеки, ма: The keeper of the Library of Alexandria, a mathematician and geographer. Knowing the distance between the cities, he obtained a circumference of the Earth of about 250,000 stadia; depending on the length of the stadion, this is anything from almost exact to 10–15% off.
Это одно из первых измерений планетарног: This is one of the first measurements on a planetary scale, made with a stick, a shadow and geometry. A good example of what the lower bank of the river means.
Звёзды медленно смещаются относительно т: The stars slowly shift relative to the equinox points: the Earth’s axis traces a cone. This is precession.
Составил один из первых звёздных каталог: He compiled one of the first star catalogs and introduced the scale of stellar brightness that astronomers still use (magnitudes). By comparing his observations with earlier ones, he discovered precession.
Прецессия — полный оборот примерно за 26: Precession, a full turn in about 26,000 years, is the very “great year” that later traditions linked to the change of ages. In the Cosmic Calendar this cycle takes up about a minute.
Свет идёт от предметов в глаз, а не из г: Light travels from objects into the eye, not out of the eye; every claim must be tested by experiment.
Его «Книга оптики» (≈ 1011–1021) объясни: His “Book of Optics” (≈1011–1021) explained vision as light entering the eye and described the camera obscura, refraction and reflection, all backed by experiments.
Ибн аль-Хайсама называют одним из отцов: Ibn al-Haytham is called one of the fathers of the experimental method. Kepler read his work through Latin translations and the optics of Witelo.
Земля — планета: она вращается вокруг ос: The Earth is a planet: it spins on its axis and revolves around the Sun along with the other planets.
Каноник из Фромборка десятилетиями работ: A canon of Frombork, he worked for decades on the book “On the Revolutions of the Heavenly Spheres”. According to tradition, a printed copy was brought to him on the day of his death in 1543.
Система Коперника ещё держалась за круго: The Copernican system still clung to circular orbits and was no more accurate than Ptolemy’s. But it changed humanity’s place in the universe. Hence the phrase “Copernican revolution”.
Планеты движутся по эллипсам, и их перио: The planets move in ellipses, and their periods are tied to their distances by an exact law: this is the harmony of the world.
Опираясь на точнейшие наблюдения Тихо Бр: Building on the extremely precise observations of Tycho Brahe, Kepler derived three laws of planetary motion. The first two appeared in “New Astronomy” (1609), the third in “The Harmony of the World” (1619).
Кеплер был мистиком и учёным одновременн: Kepler was a mystic and a scientist at once. He sought the music of the planets and the five Platonic solids between the orbits, and for the sake of precision he gave up a beloved hypothesis when it disagreed with the data by eight minutes of arc.
Книга природы написана языком математики: The book of nature is written in the language of mathematics; to read it, one must look and measure, with a telescope and a pendulum in hand.
В 1610 году в «Звёздном вестнике» Галиле: In 1610, in the “Starry Messenger”, Galileo reported mountains on the Moon, countless stars in the Milky Way and four moons of Jupiter, a small Copernican system right there in the sky.
Он заложил основы механики: падение тел,: He laid the foundations of mechanics: falling bodies, inertia, the relativity of motion. The trial of 1633 made him a symbol of the conflict between science and authority.
Одна и та же сила тяготения роняет яблок: The same force of gravity makes an apple fall and holds the Moon in orbit; three laws of motion describe everything from a stone to the planets.
«Математические начала натуральной филос: The “Mathematical Principles of Natural Philosophy” (1687) united heaven and Earth in one system of equations. Newton split white light into a spectrum with a prism and, in parallel with Leibniz, created calculus.
Меньше известно, что он годами занимался: Less well known is that he spent years on alchemy and the interpretation of prophecy. The economist Keynes called him “the last of the magicians” rather than the first of the scientists.
Всё можно записать двумя знаками — 0 и 1: Everything can be written with two signs, 0 and 1; the world consists of monads, and each reflects the whole universe from its own point of view.
Создатель математического анализа (незав: The creator of calculus (independently of Newton; the signs dx and ∫ are his), of a mechanical calculator and of binary arithmetic, on which all computers run.
В 1703 году он опубликовал статью о двои: In 1703 he published a paper on binary numbers and linked it to the hexagrams of the “Book of Changes”, which he received from a missionary in China. His “Monadology” speaks of mirrors reflecting the whole, an unexpected echo of Indra’s net.
Вещество не исчезает и не возникает из н: Matter does not vanish or arise from nothing; Venus has an atmosphere; there are many worlds in the universe.
Химик, физик, астроном, поэт. В 1761 год: A chemist, physicist, astronomer and poet. In 1761, observing the transit of Venus across the disk of the Sun, Lomonosov noticed a bright rim and concluded that Venus has an atmosphere.
Он развивал корпускулярную теорию вещест: He developed a corpuscular theory of matter and formulated a law of conservation of matter and motion. His ode “Evening Meditation on the Majesty of God” is about the abyss of stars and the multitude of worlds. In the Russian language Lomonosov is the first voice of Russian cosmism.
Каждый химический элемент состоит из оди: Each chemical element consists of identical atoms of its own weight, and substances combine in simple multiple ratios.
Школьный учитель-квакер превратил древню: A Quaker schoolteacher turned an ancient guess into a working theory: “A New System of Chemical Philosophy” (1808) introduced atomic weights and symbols for the elements.
Дальтон сознательно взял слово Демокрита: Dalton deliberately took Democritus’ word “atom”. He was also the first to describe color blindness, which he had himself; in some languages it is still called “Daltonism”.
Виды вымирают: в прошлом на Земле жили ж: Species go extinct: in the past the Earth was home to animals that no longer exist anywhere.
В 1796 году Кювье сравнил кости мамонта: In 1796 Cuvier compared mammoth bones with the skulls of Indian and African elephants and proved that the mammoth is a separate species that will never be found alive. Extinction became a scientific fact for the first time.
Он создал сравнительную анатомию — по не: He created comparative anatomy, reconstructing a whole animal from a few bones, and named the pterodactyl. Cuvier did not accept evolution and explained the succession of faunas by catastrophes. The layers of the Biosphere with their extinctions continue his work.

How to use the Astrolabe

A short guide, if you have opened the site for the first time.

The ring of stations

A brass ring of twelve stations: a path from the Absolute (I) through the cosmos, the Earth and the human back to the Void (XII). Scroll with the mouse wheel, swipe on a phone or use the arrow keys, and the camera moves along the ring from station to station.

Diving into a station

Hover over a station’s object and press “Dive into the station” (or simply click the object): a panel opens with tradition, science and practice. Inside you can scroll through the sections, start the practice timer and write a thought in the journal.

The four layers of every station

Tradition: what the teachings say; Science: what is established and what is only a hypothesis; Practice: an exercise with a timer; Symbol: an image, a sound, a color.

Высота «ля» веками гуляла примерно от 40: The pitch of A wandered for centuries between roughly 400 and 460 Hz; in the 1880s Verdi argued for a tuning of about 432 Hz, and 440 Hz was agreed on as the standard in the 20th century (ISO 16, 1975). The difference is about a third of a semitone. There is no reliable evidence that 432 Hz has a special effect on the body or “resonates with the Universe”: there are only small pilot studies. Tuning is a convention, not a law of nature.

В классических тантрических текстах цент: In the classical tantric texts the centers are matched with sounds, the bija syllables LAM, VAM, RAM, YAM, HAM, OM, not with frequencies: the hertz as a unit appeared only in the 19th–20th centuries. Lists of “chakra frequencies” are modern schemes by individual authors, and they differ from author to author.
Набор «частот сольфеджио» придуман в 199: The set of “solfeggio frequencies” was invented in the 1990s (J. Puleo, L. Horowitz). The medieval syllables ut-re-mi (Guido d’Arezzo, 11th century) stood for scale degrees, not hertz: absolute pitch was not measured then. There are no peer-reviewed data on sound “repairing DNA”.

● Свет, вышедший через 380 000 лет после: ● Light that set out 380,000 years after the Big Bang, when the cooling plasma became transparent. Back then it was yellow-white, about 3,000 degrees; the expansion has stretched it to microwaves — 2.725 K.
● Его нашли случайно в 1965 году: Арно П: ● It was found by chance in 1965: Arno Penzias and Robert Wilson were looking for the cause of noise in their antenna and at first blamed pigeon droppings.
● Перепады температуры — стотысячные дол: ● The temperature differences are hundred-thousandths of a degree. They are the seeds from which the galaxies grew; the best map was made by the Planck satellite.
◐ Пятна — следы звуковых волн в первично: ◐ The spots are traces of sound waves in the primordial plasma. Raised by 50 octaves, they become a hum that falls in pitch as the Universe expands — the "sound" of the early Universe.
«В начале было Слово»; в индийской тради: "In the beginning was the Word"; in the Indian tradition the world is born from sound — from the syllable Om, the first vibration. The cosmic microwave background is almost literally the first echo of the world, still sounding from every direction.
● Мы всё время купаемся в первом свете:: ● We are always bathing in the first light: in every cubic centimetre around you there are about 400 of its photons.
Слушать первозвук. Включите звук, закрой: Listening to the first sound. Turn on the sound, close your eyes and listen to the hum falling. Let your out-breath go with the sound — long, even, right to the end.
Без усиления небо ровное: 2,725 К во все: Without enhancement the sky is even: 2.725 K in every direction ●. Raise the contrast a hundred thousand times — and the seeds of future galaxies appear
